data.description: Poseł Koalicji Obywatelskiej Wojciech Król w piątek rano został doprowadzony do biura Prokuratury Europejskiej w Katowicach. Śledczy zamierzają przedstawić mu zarzuty dotyczące przestępstw korupcyjnych i przesłuchać. Sprawa ma związek z zamówieniami przy modernizacji infrastruktury tramwajowej na terenie Górnośląsko-Zagłębiowskiej Metropolii.
data.translatedTitle: MP Wojciech Król brought to the European Prosecutor's Office. He is to hear the charges
data.translatedDescription: On Friday morning, MP Wojciech Król, an MP from the Civic Coalition, was taken to the office of the European Prosecutor's Office in Katowice. Investigators intend to charge him with corruption offenses and interrogate him. The case is related to orders for the modernization of tram infrastructure in the Upper Silesian-Zagłębie Metropolis.

data.title: Produkcja przemysłowa w Polsce rozczarowała. Mocno rośnie za to inflacja producencka
data.description: Produkcja przemysłowa urosła w sierpniu w Polsce o 4,3 proc. r/r – podał w piątek Główny Urząd Statystyczny (GUS). Rośnie inflacja producencka: w sierpniu dotarła do poziomu 4,2 proc. r/r, najwyższego od trzech lat.
data.translatedTitle: Industrial production in Poland disappointed. However, producer inflation is growing strongly
data.translatedDescription: Industrial production grew by 4.3% in Poland in August. y/y – the Central Statistical Office (GUS) reported on Friday. Producer inflation is rising: in August it reached 4.2%. y/y, the highest in three years.

data.title: Jest nowy wicemarszałek Sejmu. Marcin Horała wybrany
data.description: Poseł Rozwoju Plus Marcin Horała został wybrany wicemarszałkiem Sejmu. W głosowaniu pokonał kandydata klubu PiS Marcina Ociepę.
data.translatedTitle: There is a new deputy speaker of the Sejm. Marcin Horała elected
data.translatedDescription: Development Plus MP Marcin Horała was elected deputy speaker of the Sejm. In the vote, he defeated the PiS club's candidate, Marcin Ociepa.

data.title: AfD wyprzedzone przez SPD. Zmiana lidera sondażu przed wyborami w Meklemburgii
data.description: Według najnowszego sondażu SPD wyszła na prowadzenie przed wyborami do landtagu Meklemburgii-Pomorza Przedniego, wyprzedzając AfD. W sierpniu Alternatywa dla Niemiec prowadziła w tym regionie z socjaldemokratami siedmioma punktami procentowymi.
data.translatedTitle: AfD overtaken by SPD. Change of poll leader before the elections in Mecklenburg
data.translatedDescription: According to the latest poll, the SPD took the lead before the elections to the state parliament of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, overtaking the AfD. In August, the Alternative for Germany led the Social Democrats in this region by seven percentage points.

data.title: Alerty RCB już nie tylko w SMS-ach. Wkrótce przyjdą także w mObywatelu
data.description: W ciągu kilku tygodni alerty RCB pojawią się już nie tylko w SMS-ach, ale również w aplikacji mObywatel – zapowiedział wiceminister cyfryzacji Dariusz Standerski. Gdy zagrożenie minie, obywatele będą mogli sprawdzić, co się stało.
data.translatedTitle: RCB alerts are no longer limited to text messages only. They will soon also be available in mObywatel
data.translatedDescription: Within a few weeks, RCB alerts will appear not only in text messages, but also in the mObywatel application, announced Deputy Minister of Digitization Dariusz Standerski. Once the threat has passed, citizens will be able to check what happened.

data.title: Michał Szułdrzyński. Wyścig zbrojeń AI. A jednak Donald Trump ma rację
data.description: Jeśli Zachód postanowi zwolnić tempo rozwoju AI, Chiny natychmiast to wykorzystają.
data.translatedTitle: Michał Szułdrzyński. AI arms race. Yet Donald Trump is right
data.translatedDescription: If the West decides to slow down the pace of AI development, China will immediately take advantage of it.

data.title: Z Pekinu mają zniknąć wszystkie drony. Zakaz ich posiadania nawet przez turystów
data.description: Chiny wprowadzają od niedzieli stałą strefę ograniczeń lotniczych wokół Pekinu o średnicy 600 kilometrów, obejmującą obszar porównywalny z 90 procentami powierzchni Polski. Ponadto od 15 listopada w stolicy wejdzie w życie całkowity zakaz posiadania dronów.
data.translatedTitle: All drones are to disappear from Beijing. Even tourists are prohibited from possessing them
data.translatedDescription: From Sunday, China is introducing a permanent air restriction zone around Beijing with a diameter of 600 kilometers, covering an area comparable to 90 percent of Poland. Moreover, from November 15, a total ban on owning drones will come into force in the capital.

data.title: Najdłuższy basen świata. Ma ponad 1000 metrów i widać go nawet z kosmosu
data.description: Basen San Alfonso del Mar w Chile to fenomen na skalę światową. Jest najdłuższym tego typu obiektem na Ziemi, który z orbitalnej perspektywy przypomina turkusową wstęgę nad Pacyfikiem. Pod względem powierzchni w ostatnich latach wyprzedził go gigant usytuowany w Egipcie.
data.translatedTitle: The longest swimming pool in the world. It is over 1,000 meters high and can even be seen from space
data.translatedDescription: The San Alfonso del Mar Basin in Chile is a global phenomenon. It is the longest object of this type on Earth, and from an orbital perspective it resembles a turquoise ribbon over the Pacific Ocean. In terms of area, in recent years it has been overtaken by the giant located in Egypt.

data.title: Wypłacono pierwsze zasiłki dla par jednopłciowych w Polsce. Dziemianowicz-Bąk: ZUS wie i rozumie, że miłość to miłość
data.description: Zakład Ubezpieczeń Społecznych wypłaca już pierwsze zasiłki opiekuńcze dla par jednopłciowych. Trwają rozmowy o umożliwieniu takim parom wspólnego rozliczania podatku PIT.
data.translatedTitle: The first benefits for same-sex couples in Poland were paid. Dziemianowicz-Bąk: ZUS knows and understands that love is love
data.translatedDescription: The Social Insurance Institution is already paying the first care benefits to same-sex couples. Talks are underway about enabling such couples to settle personal income tax jointly.

data.title: Niemiecki gigant zamknął już ponad 40 sklepów w Polsce. Kolejny już w przyszłym tygodniu
data.description: Sieć KiK zamknie kolejny sklep w Polsce. Mowa o placówce znajdującej się w Gorzowie Wielkopolskim. O sprawie donosi serwis DlaHandlu.pl, który zauważa, że w ostatnich miesiącach niemiecka sieć wyraźnie ogranicza liczbę swoich punktów.
data.translatedTitle: The German giant has already closed over 40 stores in Poland. Another one next week
data.translatedDescription: The KiK chain will close another store in Poland. We are talking about a facility located in Gorzów Wielkopolski. The matter is reported by DlaHandlu.pl, which notes that in recent months the German chain has clearly reduced the number of its points.

data.title: Kolejny atak Rosji na Ukrainę. Polska poderwała myśliwce
data.description: W związku z atakiem Rosji na Ukrainę w polskiej przestrzeni powietrznej operuje lotnictwo wojskowe – poinformowało Dowództwo Operacyjne. Przestrzeń powietrzna Polski nie została naruszona. Na kilkadziesiąt minut prace wstrzymały lotniska w Lublinie i Rzeszowie.
data.translatedTitle: Another Russian attack on Ukraine. Poland picked up fighters
data.translatedDescription: Due to Russia's attack on Ukraine, military aviation is operating in Polish airspace, informed the Operational Command. Polish airspace was not violated. The works were suspended at the airports in Lublin and Rzeszów for several dozen minutes.

data.title: Jan Urban odkrył karty. Jest kadra na Ligę Narodów, są debiutanci i głośne powroty
data.description: Selekcjoner reprezentacji Polski Jan Urban ogłosił nazwiska piłkarzy, których powołał na zbliżające się mecze Ligi Narodów. Na zgrupowanie, które zaczyna się w poniedziałek w Warszawie, zaprosił m.in. Wiktora Nowaka i Tymoteusza Puchacza.
data.translatedTitle: Jan Urban revealed the cards. There is a squad for the Nations League, there are debutants and high-profile returns
data.translatedDescription: The coach of the Polish national team, Jan Urban, announced the names of the players he called up for the upcoming Nations League matches. He invited, among others, to the training camp, which starts on Monday in Warsaw. Wiktor Nowak and Tymoteusz Puchacz.

data.title: Były szef samorządu radców o stażu Macieja Berka: Logika podpowiada, że nie ma tu problemu
data.description: Jeśli radca prawny złoży oświadczenie, że wykonuje zawód, to przyjmujemy, że go wykonuje. Przepisy dotyczące naszego zawodu nie przewidują mechanizmu weryfikacji tego, czy ktoś np. prowadzi kancelarię – mówi Maciej Bobrowicz, były prezes Krajowej Rady Radców Prawnych.
data.translatedTitle: Former head of the self-government of advisors with Maciej Berek's experience: Logic suggests that there is no problem here
data.translatedDescription: If a legal advisor declares that he or she practices the profession, we assume that he or she practices it. The regulations governing our profession do not provide for a mechanism for verifying whether someone, for example, runs a law firm, says Maciej Bobrowicz, former president of the National Council of Legal Advisors.

data.title: SPOT zmienia południowy wjazd do Sopotu. Mieszkania, biura i marki premium w jednym miejscu
data.description: Na granicy Sopotu i Gdańska powstaje wielofunkcyjny projekt łączący mieszkania, biura i usługi. SPOT ma zmienić charakter południowego wjazdu do kurortu, a jeszcze przed ukończeniem inwestycji przyciągnął marki dotychczas obecne przede wszystkim w Warszawie. Swój city showroom otworzy tutaj Auto Fus Group z markami Rolls-Royce, Aston Martin, McLaren oraz IDEAMM.
data.translatedTitle: SPOT changes the southern entrance to Sopot. Apartments, offices and premium brands in one place
data.translatedDescription: A multifunctional project combining apartments, offices and services is being built on the border of Sopot and Gdańsk. SPOT is intended to change the character of the southern entrance to the resort, and even before the investment is completed, it has attracted brands previously present mainly in Warsaw. Auto Fus Group with the Rolls-Royce, Aston Martin, McLaren and IDEAMM brands will open its city showroom here.

data.title: Izraelscy autorzy dokumentu o ludobójstwie w Palestynie pod ostrzałem w kraju. Powtórka banalność zła?
data.description: Yuval Abraham i Rachel Shor, laureaci Oscara za film „Nie chcemy innej ziemi" z 2024 r. o przymusowych przesiedleniach Palestyńczyków, teraz dostali w Wenecji Nagrodę Specjalną za dokument „NAZA" o ludobójstwie ukrytym pod pozorami „przypadkowych śmierci". Boją się wrócić do Izraela.
data.translatedTitle: Israeli authors of documentary on Palestinian genocide under fire at home. The banality of evil repeated?
data.translatedDescription: Yuval Abraham and Rachel Shor, Oscar winners for the 2024 film "We Don't Want Another Land" about the forced displacement of Palestinians, now received a Special Award in Venice for the documentary "NAZA" about genocide hidden under the guise of "accidental deaths". They are afraid to return to Israel.

data.title: Co z Orderem Orła Białego dla Wandy Traczyk-Stawskiej? Jest odpowiedź Kancelarii Prezydenta
data.description: Bohaterka Powstania Warszawskiego Wanda Traczyk-Stawska nie została uhonorowana za życia najwyższym polskim odznaczeniem. Radio ZET zapytało Kancelarię Prezydenta czy Karol Nawrocki rozważa pośmiertne przyznanie jej Orderu Orła Białego.
data.translatedTitle: What about the Order of the White Eagle for Wanda Traczyk-Stawska? There is a response from the Chancellery of the President
data.translatedDescription: The heroine of the Warsaw Uprising, Wanda Traczyk-Stawska, was not honored with the highest Polish distinction during her lifetime. Radio ZET asked the Chancellery of the President whether Karol Nawrocki was considering posthumously awarding her the Order of the White Eagle.

data.title: Estera Flieger: Izabela Łęcka ma kaca. „Lalka” na miarę naszych możliwości, jak „1670”
data.description: Nie mam problemu z tym, że Paweł Maślona luźno trzyma się Bolesława Prusa. Niech się Izabela Łęcka wyemancypuje i ma kaca – proszę bardzo. Ale nie przekonuje mnie „Lalka” w stylu „1670”.
data.translatedTitle: Estera Flieger: Izabela Łęcka has a hangover. "Doll" as best as we can, like "1670"
data.translatedDescription: I have no problem with Paweł Maślona loosely sticking to Bolesław Prus. Let Izabela Łęcka emancipate herself and have a hangover - please. But I'm not convinced by "The Doll" in the style of "1670".

data.title: Egzekucja w Alabamie. Skazany dokonował morderstw 28 lat temu
data.description: W Alabamie wykonano wyrok śmierci na 49-letnim Jefferym Lee, skazanym za zabójstwo dwóch osób podczas napadu na lombard w 1998 roku. Egzekucję przeprowadzono za pomocą śmiertelnego zastrzyku.
data.translatedTitle: Execution in Alabama. The convict committed the murders 28 years ago
data.translatedDescription: In Alabama, 49-year-old Jeffery Lee, convicted of murdering two people during a pawn shop robbery in 1998, was executed. The execution was carried out by lethal injection.

data.title: Bogdan Święczkowski: Nie dam się zastraszyć
data.description: Nie wyobrażam sobie zamachu na konstytucyjny organ, jakim jest Trybunał Konstytucyjny, w demokratycznym państwie prawa – mówi „Rzeczpospolitej” Bogdan Święczkowski, prezes TK.
data.translatedTitle: Bogdan Święczkowski: I will not be intimidated
data.translatedDescription: I cannot imagine an attack on a constitutional body, such as the Constitutional Tribunal, in a democratic state of law, says Bogdan Święczkowski, president of the Constitutional Tribunal, to "Rzeczpospolita".

data.title: Kaszel, który nie mija, może być sygnałem poważnej choroby płuc
data.description: Przewlekły kaszel często próbujemy przeczekać albo leczymy domowymi sposobami. Tymczasem może być jednym z pierwszych objawów wielu chorób płuc, w tym chorób śródmiąższowych płuc. Problemem pozostaje niska świadomość tych schorzeń i zbyt późne zgłaszanie się pacjentów do lekarza.
data.translatedTitle: A cough that does not go away may be a sign of a serious lung disease
data.translatedDescription: We often try to wait out a chronic cough or treat it with home remedies. Meanwhile, it may be one of the first symptoms of many lung diseases, including interstitial lung diseases. The problem remains low awareness of these diseases and patients reporting to a doctor too late.

data.title: V Bílém domě máte přítele, ujistil Kennedy  odpůrce očkování. Prověří chemtrails
data.description: Americký ministr zdravotnictví Robert F. Kennedy mladší vystoupil na konferenci organizace Children’s Health Defense, kterou založil. Odpůrcům očkování slíbil, že mají spojence v Bílém domě. Jeho vystoupení se odehrálo v době, kdy se Spojené státy potýkají s největším šířením spalniček za desítky let. Na konferenci skupiny Children’s Health Defense, kde promluvil, zazněly dezinformace o očkování včetně tvrzení, že úspěch vakcín proti dětské obrně je podvod.
data.translatedTitle: You have a friend in the White House, Kennedy assured vaccination opponents. They will check for chemtrails
data.translatedDescription: US Secretary of Health Robert F. Kennedy Jr. spoke at a conference of the Children's Health Defense organization he founded. He promised vaccination opponents that they have allies in the White House. His appearance came at a time when the United States is dealing with the largest outbreak of measles in decades. At a Children's Health Defense group conference where he spoke, there was misinformation about vaccinations, including claims that the success of polio vaccines is a hoax.

data.title: „Babišův“ Euro Patriot má smysl, nesmí ale tříštit NATO, míní Bříza. Zmínil velký rozpor
data.description: Myšlenka vybudovat ryze evropskou protivzdušnou obranu dává strategický smysl, od hotového systému je ale zatím daleko, říká v rozhovoru pro iDNES.cz analytik Vlastislav Bříza. Reaguje tak na čtvrteční výrok premiéra Andreje Babiše, který vyzval ke vzniku společného evropského programu protiraketové obrany Euro Patriot. Expert vysvětluje, proč moderní protiraketový štít nesmí vznikat jako konkurence NATO a jaké konkrétní vrstvy ochrany dnes Evropě fatálně chybějí.
data.translatedTitle: "Babiš's" Euro Patriot makes sense, but it must not tear NATO apart, Bříza thinks. He mentioned a big discrepancy
data.translatedDescription: The idea of ​​building a purely European air defense makes strategic sense, but it is still far from a finished system, says analyst Vlastislav Bříza in an interview for iDNES.cz. He is thus reacting to Thursday's statement by Prime Minister Andrej Babiš, who called for the creation of a joint European anti-missile defense program Euro Patriot. The expert explains why a modern anti-missile shield must not be created as a competitor to NATO and what specific layers of protection are fatally lacking in Europe today.

data.title: Erdogan našel recept, jak obejít ústavu a znovu kandidovat, prozradil poradce
data.description: Turecký prezident Recep Tayyip Erdogan podle svého poradce Mehmeta Uçuma našel způsob, jak znovu kandidovat na prezidenta navzdory ústavnímu limitu mandátů. Podle Uçuma stačí, aby rezignoval krátce před koncem mandátu a vyvolal předčasné prezidentské volby. K tomu však potřebuje podporu poslanců i z opozičních řad.
data.translatedTitle: Erdogan found a recipe to bypass the constitution and run again, an adviser revealed
data.translatedDescription: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has found a way to run for president again despite the constitutional term limit, according to his adviser Mehmet Uçum. According to Uçum, it is enough for him to resign shortly before the end of the mandate and call early presidential elections. However, for this he needs the support of MPs from the opposition ranks as well.

data.title: Jordánský král Abdalláh II. jedná na Hradě s prezidentem Pavlem
data.description: Jordánský král Abdalláh II. je v Praze. Jedná na Hradě s prezidentem Petrem Pavlem, potom se setká také s premiérem a předsedou ANO Andrejem Babišem. Krále Abdalláha II. doprovází v Praze i jeho choť, královna Ranija. Královský pár přivítal už ve čtvrtek v podvečer na letišti ministr zahraničí a předseda Motoristů sobě Petr Macinka.
data.translatedTitle: King Abdullah II of Jordan talks with President Pavlo at the Castle
data.translatedDescription: King Abdullah II of Jordan is in Prague. He is negotiating with President Petr Pavlo at the Castle, then he will also meet Prime Minister and ANO chairman Andrej Babiš. King Abdullah II his wife, Queen Ranija, also accompanies him in Prague. The royal couple was already welcomed at the airport in the early evening on Thursday by Foreign Minister and Chairman of the Motorist Association, Petr Macinka.

data.title: Putinovi možná skutečný výsledek voleb ani neřeknou, tvrdí z Moskvy Just
data.description: V Rusku začaly parlamentní volby, jejichž výsledek podle novináře žijícího v Moskvě a spolupracovníka Lidových novin Jiřího Justa nikoho příliš nepřekvapí. Mnohem větší nervozitu mezi Rusy vyvolává otázka, co přijde po nich – zejména možnost další mobilizace. Pokud ji Vladimir Putin vyhlásí, Kreml už podle Justa nedovolí opakování masového útěku mužů ze země z roku 2022, řekl v Rozstřelu na iDNES.cz.
data.translatedTitle: Putin may not even be told the actual result of the election, claims Just from Moscow
data.translatedDescription: Parliamentary elections have started in Russia, the result of which, according to Jiří Just, a journalist living in Moscow and an associate of Lidové noviny, will not surprise anyone too much. Much more nervous among Russians is the question of what will come after them - especially the possibility of further mobilization. If Vladimir Putin declares it, the Kremlin will no longer allow a repeat of the mass flight of men from the country in 2022, he said in Rozstrěl on iDNES.cz.

data.title: Vlna bahna a trosek vysoká jako dům brala vše. Před 110 lety přišla do Desné zkáza
data.description: Před 110 lety se protrhla přehrada a obec Desnou smetla plovoucí hora dřeva a bahna. Voda brala vše, zabila desítky lidí, většinou ženy a děti. Některé oběti ani nebyly nalezeny.
data.translatedTitle: A wave of mud and debris as high as a house took everything. Destruction came to Desná 110 years ago
data.translatedDescription: 110 years ago, a dam burst and the village of Desnou was swept away by a floating mountain of wood and mud. The water took everything, killing dozens of people, mostly women and children. Some victims have not even been found.

data.title: Lobbista Janoušek žádá odškodné. Státem zabavené peníze ztratily na hodnotě
data.description: Podnikatel a lobbista Roman Janoušek podal dovolání k Nejvyššímu soudu. Domáhá se odškodnění 9,8 milionu korun v souvislosti s dřívějším stíháním v kauze Chambon. Poukazuje na to, že peníze zajištěné policií během let ztratily na hodnotě. Soud dovolání obdržel v první polovině září, potvrdila jeho mluvčí Gabriela Tomíčková.
data.translatedTitle: Lobbyist Janoušek is asking for compensation. Money confiscated by the state lost its value
data.translatedDescription: Businessman and lobbyist Roman Janoušek appealed to the Supreme Court. He is seeking compensation of 9.8 million crowns in connection with the earlier prosecution in the Chambon case. He points out that the money seized by the police has lost value over the years. The court received the appeal in the first half of September, its spokeswoman Gabriela Tomíčková confirmed.

data.title: Ochutnávka z generálky. Na letišti v Mošnově vrcholí přípravy na Dny NATO
data.description: Prudké brždění, kvílení pneumatik, výbuchy, střelba a do toho ohlušující burácení stíhačky nad hlavou. Na mošnovském letišti po celý den vrcholí přípravy na víkendové Dny NATO 2026 v Ostravě.
data.translatedTitle: A taste of the general. At the airport in Mošnov, preparations for the NATO Days are at their peak
data.translatedDescription: Sudden braking, screeching tires, explosions, gunfire and the deafening crash of a fighter overhead. Preparations for the weekend NATO Days 2026 in Ostrava are at their peak throughout the day at the Mošnov Airport.

data.title: V Rusku začaly volby. Výsledek je daný, Putin je využije k legitimizaci svých kroků
data.description: V Rusku odstartovalo třídenní hlasování, ve kterém ruští voliči zvolí poslance Státní dumy. Jde o první volby od rozpoutání války Ruska proti Ukrajině. Očekává se, že ve volbách, přísně kontrolovaných Kremlem, opět zvítězí vládnoucí strana Jednotné Rusko, podporující ruského prezidenta Vladimira Putina.
data.translatedTitle: Elections have started in Russia. The result is given, Putin will use them to legitimize his actions
data.translatedDescription: A three-day vote has started in Russia, in which Russian voters will elect members of the State Duma. This is the first election since the start of Russia's war against Ukraine. The ruling United Russia party, which backs Russian President Vladimir Putin, is expected to win the election, which is tightly controlled by the Kremlin.

data.title: Ceny Thálie 2026
data.description: Divadelní Ceny Thálie budou vyhlášeny v sobotu 3. října 2026 na slavnostním večeru v historické budově Národního divadla. Ceremoniál bude v přímém přenosu od 20 hodin vysílat Česká televize.
data.translatedTitle: Thalia Awards 2026
data.translatedDescription: The Thalia Theater Awards will be announced on Saturday, October 3, 2026 at a gala evening in the historic building of the National Theatre. Czech Television will broadcast the ceremony live from 8 p.m.

data.title: Itálie chce poslat vojenské lodě proti Húsíům do průlivu Báb al-Mandab
data.description: Itálie je připravena vyslat své vojenské lodě do průlivu Báb al-Mandab nad rámec unijní námořní mise Aspides. Uvedl to ministr obrany Guido Crosetto. Podle něj by vojenská plavidla měla chránit italské nákladní lodě, aniž by bylo nutné čekat na „evropskou byrokracii“. V posledních týdnech roste znepokojení ohledně situace v průlivu kvůli ofenzivě jemenských povstalců z řad Húsíů.
data.translatedTitle: Italy wants to send warships against the Houthis in the Bab al-Mandab Strait
data.translatedDescription: Italy is ready to send its warships to the Báb al-Mandab strait in addition to the EU naval mission Aspides. This was stated by the Minister of Defense Guido Crosetto. According to him, military vessels should protect Italian cargo ships without having to wait for "European bureaucracy". In recent weeks, there has been growing concern about the situation in the strait due to an offensive by Yemen's Houthi rebels.

data.title: Vinen. Soud potvrdil psychiatru Cimickému pětiletý trest, k jednání nedorazil
data.description: Městský soud v Praze v pátek definitivně potvrdil trest pro psychiatra Jana Cimického. Odvolací senát tak pravomocně poslal lékaře na pět let do vězení a zakázal mu výkon lékařské praxe na deset let za sexuální útoky a vydírání téměř čtyř desítek žen. Soud zamítl odvolání a ztotožnil se s původním verdiktem Obvodního soudu pro Prahu 8 z konce dubna, čímž několikaletá kauza dospěla k rozsudku.
data.translatedTitle: Guilty. The court confirmed a five-year sentence for psychiatrist Cimická, he did not attend the hearing
data.translatedDescription: On Friday, the Municipal Court in Prague definitively confirmed the sentence for psychiatrist Jan Cimický. The appeals panel sent the doctor to prison for five years and banned him from practicing medicine for ten years for sexually assaulting and blackmailing almost four dozen women. The court rejected the appeal and agreed with the original verdict of the District Court for Prague 8 from the end of April, bringing the several-year case to a verdict.

data.title: Konec kolon a zbytečného stání na semaforech. Novinka zkracuje příjezd k obchodnímu centru
data.description: Řidiči přijíždějící k obchodnímu centru v Praze na Zličíně od pátečního rána nemusejí stát v dlouhých kolonách. Po letech příprav a téměř roční realizaci se otevřel druhý vjezd a výjezd k Metropoli. Nově se sem motoristé dostanou pohodlně z Rozvadovské spojky.
data.translatedTitle: The end of queues and unnecessary standing at traffic lights. The novelty shortens the journey to the shopping center
data.translatedDescription: Drivers arriving at the Zličín shopping center in Prague do not have to stand in long queues from Friday morning. After years of preparation and almost a year of implementation, the second entrance and exit to the Metropolis was opened. Motorists will now be able to get here conveniently from the Rozvadovské spojka.

data.title: Sociální demokraté v Meklenbursku předstihli AfD, ukázal průzkum před volbami
data.description: Nedělní volby v Meklenbursku-Předním Pomořansku podle nového průzkumu vyhraje sociální demokracie (SPD), Alternativa pro Německo (AfD) skončí s rozdílem procentního bodu na druhém místě. Průzkum institutu Forschungsgruppe Wahlen (FGW) je letos první, podle kterého nevyhraje AfD. V Berlíně, kde se rovněž v neděli konají volby, předpovídá průzkum vítězství Levice před křesťanskými demokraty (CDU) kancléře Friedricha Merze.
data.translatedTitle: The Social Democrats have overtaken the AfD in Mecklenburg, a pre-election poll showed
data.translatedDescription: Sunday's elections in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, according to a new poll, will be won by the Social Democracy (SPD), Alternative for Germany (AfD) will end up in second place with a difference of one percentage point. The poll by the Forschungsgruppe Wahlen (FGW) is the first this year that the AfD will not win. In Berlin, where elections are also held on Sunday, a poll predicts a victory for the Left over Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democrats (CDU).

data.title: Volby v Uherském Hradišti: Blaha může být počtvrté starostou, problém je parkování
data.description: Hotový nový zimní stadion a proměna městské dopravy jsou dva hlavní dokončené projekty současného vedení Uherského Hradiště v uplynulém čtyřletém období. Opozice kritizuje nerealizovaný systém rezidentního parkování. Co město čeká po volbách? Redakce iDNES.cz přináší odpovědi na zásadní otázky.
data.translatedTitle: Elections in Uherské Hradiště: Blaha can be mayor for the fourth time, the problem is parking
data.translatedDescription: The completed new winter stadium and the transformation of city transport are the two main completed projects of the current management of Uherské Hradiště in the past four years. The opposition criticizes the unimplemented resident parking system. What awaits the city after the elections? The editors of iDNES.cz bring answers to fundamental questions.

data.title: Tragédie na Českobudějovicku, po nárazu do stromu v autě uhořel člověk
data.description: Tragická nehoda se stala ráno na Českobudějovicku. Auto tam vyjelo ze silnice a po nárazu do stromu začalo hořet. Uhořel v něm jeden člověk. Okolnosti a příčiny nehody vyšetřují policisté.
data.translatedTitle: Tragedy in České Budějovice, a person burned to death in a car after hitting a tree
data.translatedDescription: A tragic accident happened in the morning on Českobudějovick. The car left the road there and caught fire after hitting a tree. One person was burned in it. The circumstances and causes of the accident are being investigated by the police.

data.title: Praha na svých pozemcích regulovala výdejní boxy. Jinde pravidla neplatí
data.description: Lidem v libeňské Kubišově ulici dlouhodobě vadí, že je v ní výdejní box GLS. Nelíbí se jim, že kvůli němu ztratili výhled na Prahu, a také to, že kvůli zásobování do ulice přijíždí více aut. Petici za jeho odstranění podepsalo přes 200 lidí. Prozatím místní dosáhli jen toho, že box změnil barvu na světle šedivou a kousek se posunul, aby nezasahoval na městský pozemek.
data.translatedTitle: Prague regulated delivery boxes on its properties. Elsewhere, the rules do not apply
data.translatedDescription: People in Libeň's Kubišová street have long been bothered by the fact that there is a GLS delivery box there. They don't like that they lost their view of Prague because of it, and also that more cars come to the street for supplies. Over 200 people signed a petition for its removal. So far, the locals have only achieved that the box has changed its color to light gray and moved a bit so that it does not encroach on the city property.

data.title: Nejdřív přijde varovná SMS, pak výbuch. Ruské drony děsí obyvatele Rumunska
data.description: Nejdříve přijde varovná SMS, pak se ozve výbuch. Pro osmačtyřicetiletého Roberta Mariana z rumunského města Isaccea se ruské drony útočící jen několik set metrů přes Dunaj staly zdrojem nekončícího strachu. „Dostáváme varování, že něco přijde. Stalo se to před dvěma, možná třemi týdny. Byla půlnoc a já spal... Jedno bylo tišší, ale další bylo opravdu hlasité. Dostal jsem strach a vyběhl z domu,“ popsal jednu z nocí.
data.translatedTitle: First comes a warning SMS, then an explosion. Russian drones scare the people of Romania
data.translatedDescription: First comes a warning SMS, then an explosion. For 48-year-old Robert Marian from the Romanian city of Isaccea, Russian drones attacking just a few hundred meters across the Danube became a source of endless fear. "We get a warning that something is coming. It happened two, maybe three weeks ago. It was midnight and I was sleeping... One was quieter, but the next one was really loud. I got scared and ran out of the house," he described one night.

data.title: Špidla ve videu shání lidi do nové strany. Varuje před rostoucí nerovností
data.description: Expremiér Vladimír Špidla vysvětluje v novém videu důvody, které vedly k založení Nové sociální demokracie. Mluví v něm o rostoucích majetkových rozdílech, nerovném přístupu k veřejným službám, koncentraci ekonomické a politické moci i o pocitu části společnosti, že na své problémy zůstává sama.
data.translatedTitle: In the video, Špidla finds people in a new party. It warns of growing inequality
data.translatedDescription: Former Prime Minister Vladimír Špidla explains in a new video the reasons that led to the establishment of the New Social Democracy. In it, he talks about growing wealth differences, unequal access to public services, the concentration of economic and political power, and the feeling of part of society that it is left alone with its problems.

data.title: Sestra Kim Čong-una hrozí odvetou za cvičení USA. KLDR posílí jaderné zbraně
data.description: Sestra severokorejského vůdce Kim Čong-una Kim Jo-čong varovala před „útočnější“ reakcí Pchjongjangu na vojenská cvičení Spojených států a jejich spojenců. Za hlavní zdroj rostoucího napětí na Korejském poloostrově označila manévry vedené USA a zároveň uvedla, že Severní Korea bude dál posilovat svůj jaderný arzenál.
data.translatedTitle: Kim Jong-un's sister threatens retaliation for US drills. The DPRK will strengthen its nuclear weapons
data.translatedDescription: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's sister, Kim Yo-jong, has warned of a "more aggressive" response by Pyongyang to military exercises by the United States and its allies. She identified the US-led maneuvers as the main source of growing tensions on the Korean Peninsula, and at the same time said that North Korea will continue to strengthen its nuclear arsenal.

data.title: Od prezidenta či Reichela. Tepličan vydraží kravaty pro děti, sehnal cenné kusy
data.description: Pětadvacet kravat známých osobností bude v pondělí 21. září v 18 hodin dražit František Erbert z Teplic. Výtěžek aukce, která se koná v Zahradním domě, je určen pro Dětský domov Tuchlov.
data.translatedTitle: From the president or Reichel. Tepličan is auctioning ties for children, he got valuable pieces
data.translatedDescription: Twenty-five neckties of famous personalities will be auctioned off on Monday, September 21 at 6 p.m. by František Erbert from Teplice. The proceeds of the auction, which takes place in the Garden House, are intended for the Tuchlov Children's Home.

data.title: Íránci zaútočili na ropný tanker v Hormuzském průlivu. Loď začala hořet
data.description: Íránské revoluční gardy zaútočily v Hormuzském průlivu na ropný tanker plující pod vlajkou Toga. Podle íránských státních médií loď po zásahu začala hořet. Osud posádky zatím není známý a není ani potvrzené, zda jde o stejné plavidlo, u kterého ve čtvrtek večer hlásila bezpečnostní incident britská agentura UKMTO.
data.translatedTitle: The Iranians attacked an oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. The ship caught fire
data.translatedDescription: Iran's Revolutionary Guards attacked an oil tanker flying the flag of Togo in the Strait of Hormuz. According to Iranian state media, the ship caught fire after the strike. The fate of the crew is not yet known, and it is not even confirmed whether it is the same vessel with which the British agency UKMTO reported a security incident on Thursday evening.

data.title: Kvůli jedné chybě majitelé nemovitostí tratí miliony. Třetina Čechů ji stále dělá
data.description: Mnoho Čechů stále žije v iluzi, že jejich pojistná smlouva sjednaná před více než pěti lety je dostatečná. Aktuální data však ukazují, že podpojištění je v Česku masivním problémem, který může při kompletní škodě připravit rodinu o miliony korun. Nejméně 30 % tuzemských nemovitostí není dokonce pojištěno vůbec.
data.translatedTitle: Property owners lose millions because of one mistake. A third of Czechs still do it
data.translatedDescription: Many Czechs still live in the illusion that their insurance contract negotiated more than five years ago is sufficient. However, current data show that underinsurance is a massive problem in the Czech Republic, which can deprive a family of millions of crowns in the event of a complete loss. At least 30% of domestic properties are not even insured at all.

data.title: Jak ochránit lidi nad přehradou? Problém obcí na Bruntálsku už řeší i projektanti
data.description: Řeka tam umí být nebezpečná. Když se rozvodní, s obrovskou energií ničí vše, co jí stojí v cestě. Vyrazí nové koryto, bourá domy, odnáší silnice. Obce na horním toku Opavy proto netrpělivě vyhlížejí nová protipovodňová opatření. Chtějí lepší ochranu, než měly před povodní. Každá však trochu jiným způsobem
data.translatedTitle: How to protect people above the dam? Planners are already solving the problem of municipalities in Bruntál Region
data.translatedDescription: The river can be dangerous there. When it unleashes, it destroys everything in its path with tremendous energy. He digs a new riverbed, demolishes houses, carries away roads. The municipalities on the upper reaches of the Opava are therefore impatiently waiting for new anti-flood measures. They want better protection than they had before the flood. However, each in a slightly different way

data.title: Vyškov řeší, co s prostorem vedle zámku. Nabízí se minipivovar i místo pro spolky
data.description: Z nejméně kandidátek letos mají na jihu Moravy na výběr Vyškované. O hlasy se uchází sedm uskupení, což je nejnižší počet v tomto tisíciletí. Naposledy vyhrálo ANO před hnutím VY a ODS. Čtvrté místo bralo SPD před lidovci. Následný souboj mezi STAN s podporou Volby pro město a Naším Vyškovem ovládli Starostové. Sdružení Transparentní Vyškov je nováčkem.
data.translatedTitle: Vyškov is deciding what to do with the space next to the castle. There is a microbrewery and a place for associations
data.translatedDescription: Among the few candidates this year, Vyškové has a choice in the south of Moravia. Seven groups are vying for votes, the lowest number this millennium. The last time ANO won before the VY movement and the ODS. The fourth place was taken by the SPD ahead of the People's Party. The subsequent battle between STAN with the support of Elections for the City and Naší Vyškov was dominated by the Starostov. The Transparent Vyškov association is a newcomer.

data.title: Myslivci zastřelili rekordní počet divočáků. Přesto jich může dál přibývat
data.description: Myslivci za sebou mají rekordní sezonu. Podle údajů Českého statistického úřadu za poslední myslivecký rok, tedy od dubna do března, skolili meziročně o 41,2 procenta více divokých prasat, padlo jich tak 273 725. Rekordy padly i u střílení srnek nebo daňků.
data.translatedTitle: Hunters shot a record number of wild boars. Nevertheless, they may continue to increase
data.translatedDescription: Hunters have had a record season. According to data from the Czech Statistical Office, during the last hunting year, i.e. from April to March, they killed 41.2 percent more wild pigs year-on-year, 273,725 of them. Records were also broken for the shooting of roe deer and fallow deer.

data.title: Kolik rozdali ministři na odměnách? Nejvíc vyplatil Zůna, jinak nová vláda šetří
data.description: Babišovi ministři poprvé od nástupu do funkce rozdávali pololetní odměny zaměstnancům svých resortů. Celkem na ně vyčlenili 369 milionů korun, tedy zhruba o pětinu méně, než při posledním odměňování rozdělila odcházející vláda Petra Fialy (ODS). Nejvyšší bonus vyplatilo ministerstvo obrany Jaromíra Zůny (SPD). Vrchnímu řediteli jedné ze sekcí resort poslal 450 tisíc korun.
data.translatedTitle: How much did the ministers give out on rewards? Zuna paid the most, otherwise the new government is saving money
data.translatedDescription: For the first time since taking office, Babiš's ministers distributed half-yearly bonuses to the employees of their departments. In total, they allocated 369 million crowns for them, i.e. roughly a fifth less than the outgoing government of Petr Fiala (ODS) distributed during the last remuneration. The highest bonus was paid by Jaromír Zůna's Ministry of Defense (SPD). The department sent 450,000 crowns to the chief director of one of the sections.

data.title: Svět žije na dluh. Dva biliony dolarů letos padnou jen za úroky
data.description: Česká republika letos zaplatí za obsluhu státního dluhu 110 miliard korun. USA stejnou částku pošlou věřitelům na úrocích za necelé dva dny. Rychle rostoucí zadlužování není ani zdaleka jen český problém. Vlády po celém světě vytvořily monstrózní dluhovou zátěž a náklady na obsluhu dluhu pohlcují velkou část daňových příjmů. Globální veřejný dluh loni dosáhl 94 procent světového HDP a Mezinárodní měnový fond očekává, že do konce tohoto desetiletí se vyšplhá na 100 procent, upozorňují například Financial Times.
data.translatedTitle: The world lives on debt. Two trillion dollars will be lost this year in interest alone
data.translatedDescription: This year, the Czech Republic will pay 110 billion crowns to service the state debt. The US will send the same amount to creditors with interest in less than two days. Rapidly growing indebtedness is far from being a Czech problem. Governments around the world have built up monstrous debt burdens, and the cost of servicing the debt eats up a large portion of tax revenue. Global public debt reached 94 percent of world GDP last year, and the International Monetary Fund expects it to rise to 100 percent by the end of this decade, the Financial Times points out, for example.

data.title: Rusové hlasují o válce. Volby mají dodat legitimitu pokračování agrese na Ukrajině
data.description: V Rusku v pátek začínají první volby do Státní dumy od zahájení plnohodnotné invaze na Ukrajinu – a zároveň nejnudnější v postsovětských dějinách země. Vítěz, který obsadí většinu křesel v parlamentu, je jasný. Otázkou asi zůstává, jak velkou podporu vládě technokraté Vladimira Putina „nakreslí“. Kreml rámuje hlasování jako referendum o pokračování pátým rokem trvající války na Ukrajině.
data.translatedTitle: Russians vote for war. The elections are supposed to give legitimacy to the continuation of aggression in Ukraine
data.translatedDescription: In Russia, the first State Duma elections since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine - and the most boring in the country's post-Soviet history - begin on Friday. The winner who takes the majority of seats in parliament is clear. The question probably remains how much support the technocrats will "draw" for the government of Vladimir Putin. The Kremlin is framing the vote as a referendum on whether to continue the fifth-year war in Ukraine.

data.title: A Fradi edzője bátor volt, nem kért a gyáva öngyilkos taktikából
data.description: Borbély Balázs nagyszerűen készítette fel csapatát és óriási győzelmet aratott.
data.translatedTitle: The coach of Fradi was brave, he did not ask for cowardly suicidal tactics
data.translatedDescription: Balázs Borbély prepared his team superbly and won a huge victory.

data.title: Segítséget kaptak a magyarok, hogy bosszút álljanak Luxemburgban
data.description: A Magyar Teniszszövetség szakmai igazgatója felidézte korábbi élményeit a ma kezdődő párharc kapcsán.
data.translatedTitle: The Hungarians received help to take revenge in Luxembourg
data.translatedDescription: The professional director of the Hungarian Tennis Association recalled his previous experiences in connection with the duel starting today.

data.title: Húsz éve a tévészékház ostromával kezdődött 2006 véres ősze + videók
data.description: Gyurcsány Ferenc őszödi beszéde soha nem látott politikai és társadalmi válságot okozott Magyarországon.
data.translatedTitle: Twenty years ago, the bloody autumn of 2006 began with the siege of the TV headquarters + videos
data.translatedDescription: Ferenc Gyurcsány's inaugural speech caused an unprecedented political and social crisis in Hungary.

data.title: Keményen nekiment a skót sajtó a Celticnek a Fradi győzelme után
data.description: A skót csapat nem teszi ki az ablakba, amit az újságíróktól és a szakértőktől kapott.
data.translatedTitle: The Scottish press went hard on Celtic after Fradi's victory
data.translatedDescription: The Scottish team does not throw out the window what it has received from journalists and pundits.

data.title: Nemzetformáló reformkor
data.description: Nem véletlen, hogy az első magyar történelmi regény, az Abafi Erdélyben látta meg a napvilágot.
data.translatedTitle: Nation-shaping reform time
data.translatedDescription: It is no coincidence that the first Hungarian historical novel, Abafi, was published in Transylvania.

data.title: Őszöd hosszú árnyéka vetül a Tiszára
data.description: Az őszödi beszéd után húsz évvel Magyar Péter sokat köszönhet és most is támaszkodhat a Gyurcsány-korszak embereire.
data.translatedTitle: The long shadow of your autumn is cast on the Tisza
data.translatedDescription: Twenty years after the Ószöd speech, Péter Magyar has a lot to thank and can still rely on the people of the Gyurcsány era.

data.title: Örülhetnek a saját lakás tulajdonosai, nagyot ugrott a vagyonuk az elmúlt évtizedben
data.description: Magyarország a 16. helyen áll 57 ország lakáspiaci rangsorában.
data.translatedTitle: The owners of their own flats can be happy, their wealth has jumped a lot in the last decade
data.translatedDescription: Hungary ranks 16th in the housing market ranking of 57 countries.

data.title: Túl tarka szőttes a Közel-Keleten
data.description: Szudántól Pakisztánig húzódik az egyre terjedő konfliktus.
data.translatedTitle: Too colorful in the Middle East
data.translatedDescription: The growing conflict stretches from Sudan to Pakistan.

data.title: Az online színház ma már önmagában is megáll a lábán
data.description: Külföldről is sokan figyelik az eSzínház repertoárját.
data.translatedTitle: Today, online theater can stand on its own
data.translatedDescription: Many people from abroad also watch the repertoire of the eSzínház.

data.title: Mindenre képesek vagyunk
data.description: Töretlen hitre, elszántságra, bátorságra és határozott cselekvésre van szükség, és ha a megfelelő mentális állapotra visszatornázzuk magunkat, könnyen újjáépítjük a nemzeti tábort.
data.translatedTitle: We can do anything
data.translatedDescription: Unbroken faith, determination, courage and decisive action are needed, and if we restore ourselves to the right mental state, we can easily rebuild the national camp.

data.title: Elment a magyar blueskirály: mennyire ismeri Deák Bill Gyula legendás pályafutását?
data.description: A pótolhatatlan zenész 77 éves korában hunyt el, emlékét ikonikus dalai őrzik.
data.translatedTitle: The Hungarian blues king is gone: how well do you know the legendary career of Gyula Bill Deák?
data.translatedDescription: The irreplaceable musician died at the age of 77, and his iconic songs preserve his memory.

data.title: Comissão Europeia desembolsa mais 3,3 mil milhões de euros para mísseis e drones
data.description: A Comissão Europeia anunciou hoje o quarto pagamento à Ucrânia, de 3,3 mil milhões de euros para compra de drones e mísseis, ao abrigo do empréstimo de apoio ao país, de 90 mil milhões de euros.
data.translatedTitle: European Commission spends another 3.3 billion euros on missiles and drones
data.translatedDescription: The European Commission today announced the fourth payment to Ukraine, of 3.3 billion euros for the purchase of drones and missiles, under the country's 90 billion euro support loan.

data.title: Excedente próximo de zero este ano após devolução de 800 milhões em suplemento e IRS
data.description: O Governo estima que as contas públicas terminem este ano com um excedente orçamental "próximo de 0", calculando em 800 milhões de euros a devolução aos portugueses através do suplemento extraordinário aos pensionistas e da redução do IRS.
data.translatedTitle: Surplus close to zero this year after return of R$800 million in additional and IR
data.translatedDescription: The Government estimates that public accounts will end this year with a budget surplus "close to 0", estimating 800 million euros in return to the Portuguese through the extraordinary supplement for pensioners and the reduction of the IRS.

data.title: Bruxelas quer limitar redes sociais a menores
data.description: A Comissão Europeia pretende proibir o acesso de menores de 13 anos às redes sociais.
data.translatedTitle: Brussels wants to limit social networks to minors
data.translatedDescription: The European Commission intends to ban children under 13 from accessing social media.

data.title: Festa do livro regressa a Belém
data.description: Livros, autores e leitores voltam a ocupar os jardins do Palácio de Belém. A nona edição da Festa do Livro abriu portas esta quinta-feira, tendo contado com Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa e António José Seguro entre os primeiros visitantes a percorrer as bancadas do recinto.
data.translatedTitle: Book festival returns to Belém
data.translatedDescription: Books, authors and readers once again occupy the gardens of the Palácio de Belém. The ninth edition of the Book Festival opened its doors this Thursday, and had Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa and António José Seguro among the first visitors to visit the venue's stands.

data.title: 9h Alemanha: Merz está sob pressão perante avanço da AFD
data.translatedTitle: 9am Germany: Merz is under pressure as AFD advances

data.title: Pelo menos 17 mortos em acidente de viação na província moçambicana de Inhambane
data.description: Pelo menos 17 pessoas morreram e uma ficou ferida na sequência de um acidente de viação ocorrido na noite de quinta-feira, no distrito de Zavala, na província de Inhambane, sul de Moçambique, divulgou hoje a Presidência da República.
data.translatedTitle: At least 17 dead in road accident in the Mozambican province of Inhambane
data.translatedDescription: At least 17 people died and one was injured following a road accident that occurred on Thursday night, in the district of Zavala, in the province of Inhambane, southern Mozambique, the Presidency of the Republic announced today.

data.title: Governo no limite da margem orçamental
data.description: O ministro Adjunto e da Reforma do Estado, Gonçalo Matias, assegura que este é o limite máximo até onde o Governo pode ir no momento.
data.translatedTitle: Government at the limit of budgetary margin
data.translatedDescription: The Deputy Minister of State Reform, Gonçalo Matias, guarantees that this is the maximum limit to which the Government can go at the moment.

data.title: "Porta das traseiras". Max, uma aplicação russa para espiar os cidadãos
data.description: Uma investigação mostra que dezenas de milhões de pessoas estão a ser forçadas a usar uma plataforma que funciona como uma "porta das traseiras" nos seus dispositivos.
data.translatedTitle: "Back door". Max, a Russian application to spy on citizens
data.translatedDescription: Research shows that tens of millions of people are being forced to use a platform that acts as a "backdoor" into their devices.

data.title: Luís Montenegro rejeita medidas da Oposição
data.description: Numa declaração com pouco mais de 10 minutos, Luís Montenegro garantiu que o Governo não vai entrar num "leilão de medidas avulsas" que conduziria o país à "tragédia".
data.translatedTitle: Luís Montenegro rejects Opposition measures
data.translatedDescription: In a statement lasting just over 10 minutes, Luís Montenegro guaranteed that the government will not enter into an "auction of separate measures" that would lead the country to "tragedy".

data.title: Governo prolonga apoios aos Combustíveis
data.description: Perante a subida do preço dos combustíveis, o Governo vai prolongar o pacote de apoios à economia.
data.translatedTitle: Government extends support for Fuels
data.translatedDescription: Given the rise in fuel prices, the Government will extend the support package for the economy.

data.title: IA: uma corrida difícil de travar
data.translatedTitle: AI: a tough race to stop

data.title: 8h Líder do PS não ficou convencido com declaração de Montenegro
data.translatedTitle: 8am PS leader was not convinced by Montenegro's statement

data.title: Conselho de MInistros. Menos IRS e apoio a Pensionistas
data.description: O Governo aprovou a descida das taxas de IRS até ao sexto escalão. Na prática, a medida traz um alívio fiscal estimado entre 12 e 171 euros por ano para contribuintes solteiros sem filhos, refletindo-se de forma imediata no subsídio de Natal e nos salários de novembro.
data.translatedTitle: Council of Ministers. Less IRS and support for Pensioners
data.translatedDescription: The Government approved the reduction of IRS rates up to the sixth level. In practice, the measure brings tax relief estimated at between R$12 and R$171 per year for single taxpayers without children, immediately reflected in the Christmas bonus and November salaries.

data.title: Investigadoras defendem atualidade e projeção global da poeta
data.description: Investigadoras de diversas nacionalidades defenderam que a poesia libertadora de Noémia de Sousa, que completaria cem anos no domingo, é atual, alertando para a necessidade de superar barreiras académicas e traduzir a sua obra globalmente.
data.translatedTitle: Researchers defend the poet’s relevance and global projection
data.translatedDescription: Researchers from different nationalities argued that the liberating poetry of Noémia de Sousa, who would have turned one hundred years old on Sunday, is current, warning of the need to overcome academic barriers and translate her work globally.

data.title: Indonésia torna-se o segundo país do Sudeste Asiático a ter porta-aviões
data.description: A Indonésia recebeu hoje o seu primeiro porta-aviões, um antigo navio de guerra italiano que, segundo o Governo, reforçará as capacidades de segurança marítima e de resposta a catástrofes do arquipélago.
data.translatedTitle: Indonesia becomes the second country in Southeast Asia to have an aircraft carrier
data.translatedDescription: Indonesia today received its first aircraft carrier, a former Italian warship that, according to the Government, will strengthen the archipelago's maritime security and disaster response capabilities.

data.title: PNUD quer reduzir pobreza e criar emprego em Moçambique com novo programa até 2030
data.description: O novo programa de cooperação do PNUD para Moçambique até 2030 pretende reduzir a incidência da pobreza, criar emprego, reforçar a resiliência climática e diminuir a dependência dos setores extrativos, prevendo investimentos de 89 milhões de euros nestas áreas.
data.translatedTitle: UNDP wants to reduce poverty and create jobs in Mozambique with new program until 2030
data.translatedDescription: The new UNDP cooperation program for Mozambique until 2030 aims to reduce the incidence of poverty, create jobs, strengthen climate resilience and reduce dependence on extractive sectors, foreseeing investments of 89 million euros in these areas.

data.title: Novo programa do PNUD para Moçambique quer reforçar instituições e acesso à justiça
data.description: O novo programa de cooperação do PNUD para Moçambique até 2030 prevê reforçar instituições públicas, melhorar o acesso à justiça e consolidar os processos de paz e participação democrática, num plano orçado em quase 150 milhões de euros.
data.translatedTitle: New UNDP program for Mozambique aims to strengthen institutions and access to justice
data.translatedDescription: The new UNDP cooperation program for Mozambique until 2030 envisages strengthening public institutions, improving access to justice and consolidating peace processes and democratic participation, in a plan budgeted at almost 150 million euros.

data.title: Rei da Malásia autoriza ex-PM a cumprir pena por corrupção em prisão domiciliar
data.description: O rei da Malásia concedeu hoje um perdão condicional ao ex-primeiro-ministro Najib Razak, permitindo que o antigo governante, preso desde 2022 por corrupção, cumpra o restante da pena em regime de prisão domiciliária.
data.translatedTitle: King of Malaysia authorizes former PM to serve sentence for corruption under house arrest
data.translatedDescription: The King of Malaysia today granted a conditional pardon to former Prime Minister Najib Razak, allowing the former ruler, imprisoned since 2022 for corruption, to serve the remainder of his sentence under house arrest.

data.title: 7h Montenegro anuncia pacote anti-crise do governo
data.translatedTitle: 7am Montenegro announces government anti-crisis package

data.title: Timor-Leste declara como Património Cultural Nacional arquitetura de origem portuguesa em Díli e Liquiçá
data.description: Timor-Leste declarou como Património Cultural Nacional a arquitetura portuguesa dos municípios de Díli e Liquiçá, bem como a Paisagem Cultural de Tutuala, no leste do país, informou hoje na sua página oficial o Governo timorense.
data.translatedTitle: Timor-Leste declares architecture of Portuguese origin in Díli and Liquiçá as National Cultural Heritage
data.translatedDescription: Timor-Leste declared the Portuguese architecture of the municipalities of Díli and Liquiçá as National Cultural Heritage, as well as the Cultural Landscape of Tutuala, in the east of the country, the Timorese Government reported today on its official website.

data.title: Títulos do Tesouro dos EUA detidos pela China caem para mínimo desde 2008
data.description: Os títulos de dívida pública dos Estados Unidos detidos pela China caíram em julho para o nível mais baixo desde 2008, num contexto de crescente diversificação das reservas de Pequim para ativos como ouro e outros títulos norte-americanos.
data.translatedTitle: US Treasuries held by China fall to lowest since 2008
data.translatedDescription: US government bonds held by China fell in July to their lowest level since 2008, amid Beijing's increasing diversification of reserves into assets such as gold and other US securities.

data.title: Vinte concelhos de sete distritos em perigo máximo de incêndio
data.description: Vinte concelhos dos distritos de Viseu, Guarda, Coimbra, Castelo Branco, Santarém, Portalegre e Faro estão hoje em perigo máximo de incêndio rural, segundo o Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera (IPMA).
data.translatedTitle: Twenty councils from seven districts at maximum fire danger
data.translatedDescription: Twenty municipalities in the districts of Viseu, Guarda, Coimbra, Castelo Branco, Santarém, Portalegre and Faro are currently at maximum risk from rural fires, according to the Portuguese Institute of the Sea and Atmosphere (IPMA).

data.title: Comunidade imigrante em Tulare mantém "um grande sentido de pertença" aos Açores
data.description: A comunidade portuguesa e lusodescendente de Tulare, na Califórnia, mantém "um grande sentido de pertença" aos Açores e contribui para a preservação das tradições, disse à Lusa a presidente da Câmara Municipal de Angra do Heroísmo, Fátima Martins.
data.translatedTitle: Immigrant community in Tulare maintains "a great sense of belonging" to the Azores
data.translatedDescription: The Portuguese and Portuguese-descendant community of Tulare, California, maintains "a great sense of belonging" to the Azores and contributes to the preservation of traditions, the president of the Angra do Heroísmo City Council, Fátima Martins, told Lusa.

data.title: Liga das Nações. Jesus anuncia primeira lista de convocados à frente da seleção
data.description: Jorge Jesus revela esta sexta-feira a sua primeira lista de convocados como selecionador de futebol de Portugal, tendo em vista a defesa do título da Liga das Nações. Acompanhamos aqui, ao minuto, o anúncio do técnico.
data.translatedTitle: League of Nations. Jesus announces first list of players called up ahead of the national team
data.translatedDescription: Jorge Jesus reveals this Friday his first squad list as Portugal's football coach, aiming to defend the Nations League title. We follow the coach's announcement here, up to the minute.

data.title: Jornadas Europeias do Património a partir de hoje com centenas de atividades em Portugal
data.description: As Jornadas Europeias do Património, iniciativa do Conselho da Europa e da Comissão Europeia, decorrem em Portugal a partir de hoje, até dia 27, com mais de 400 atividades já assinaladas pelo país, segundo o instituto Património Cultural
data.translatedTitle: European Heritage Days starting today with hundreds of activities in Portugal
data.translatedDescription: The European Heritage Days, an initiative of the Council of Europe and the European Commission, take place in Portugal from today until the 27th, with more than 400 activities already scheduled across the country, according to the Cultural Heritage Institute

data.title: Detido alegado assassino de estudante espanhola de 21 anos no México
data.description: As autoridades mexicanas anunciaram na quinta-feira a detenção do alegado assassino de uma estudante espanhola que se encontrava no país no âmbito de um programa de intercâmbio universitário.
data.translatedTitle: Alleged killer of 21-year-old Spanish student arrested in Mexico
data.translatedDescription: Mexican authorities announced on Thursday the arrest of the alleged killer of a Spanish student who was in the country as part of a university exchange program.

data.title: China assinala 95.º aniversário da invasão japonesa entre tensões com Tóquio
data.description: A China assinalou hoje o 95.º aniversário do chamado "Incidente de 18 de Setembro", considerado por Pequim o início da invasão japonesa da Manchúria e de 14 anos de guerra contra o Japão, num contexto de tensões bilaterais.
data.translatedTitle: China marks 95th anniversary of Japanese invasion amid tensions with Tokyo
data.translatedDescription: China today marked the 95th anniversary of the so-called "September 18 Incident", considered by Beijing to be the beginning of the Japanese invasion of Manchuria and 14 years of war against Japan, in a context of bilateral tensions.

data.title: Moeda chinesa atinge valor mais alto face ao dólar desde julho de 2022
data.description: O yuan atingiu hoje o valor mais alto face ao dólar desde julho de 2022, após sinais de apoio do banco central chinês e a poucos dias do previsto encontro entre os presidentes da China e dos Estados Unidos.
data.translatedTitle: Chinese currency reaches highest value against the dollar since July 2022
data.translatedDescription: The yuan today reached its highest value against the dollar since July 2022, after signs of support from the Chinese central bank and just a few days before the scheduled meeting between the presidents of China and the United States.

data.title: Austrália vai passar a prender turistas que ultrapassem prazo dos vistos
data.description: O Governo da Austrália indicou hoje que irá passar a colocar os turistas que ultrapassem a duração autorizada dos seus vistos em detenção administrativa, no âmbito de um endurecimento das políticas de imigração do país.
data.translatedTitle: Australia will start arresting tourists who overstay their visas
data.translatedDescription: The Australian Government indicated today that it will place tourists who overstay their visas in administrative detention, as part of a tightening of the country's immigration policies.

data.title: Coreia do Sul nega planos para enviar forças armadas para estreito de Ormuz
data.description: O Presidente sul-coreano negou hoje que o país esteja a ponderar enviar um destacamento das suas forças armadas para o estreito de Ormuz, ou qualquer outra participação no conflito entre os Estados Unidos e o Irão.
data.translatedTitle: South Korea denies plans to send armed forces to Strait of Hormuz
data.translatedDescription: The South Korean President today denied that the country is considering sending a detachment of its armed forces to the Strait of Hormuz, or any other participation in the conflict between the United States and Iran.

data.title: Colômbia abandona coligação internacional para defesa dos direitos LGBT
data.description: O Governo da Colômbia decidiu na quinta-feira retirar o país da Coligação para a Igualdade de Direitos (ERC, na sigla em inglês), um grupo de 45 países que promove a defesa dos direitos da comunidade LGBT.
data.translatedTitle: Colombia abandons international coalition to defend LGBT rights
data.translatedDescription: The Government of Colombia decided on Thursday to withdraw the country from the Coalition for Equal Rights (ERC), a group of 45 countries that promotes the defense of the rights of the LGBT community.

data.title: Reabertura do Teatro Nacional Dona Maria II. Mais democrático, convidativo e aberto à cidade
data.description: Terminadas as obras de requalificação, que levaram ao encerramento do edifício durante três anos, o Teatro Nacional Dona Maria II reabre portas, esta sexta-feira, com uma programação de três dias, uma casa melhorada e aberta a todos - e uma peça de William Shakespeare que desafia qualquer fantasma e superstição que assombre este espaço cultural.
data.translatedTitle: Reopening of the Dona Maria II National Theater. More democratic, inviting and open to the city
data.translatedDescription: After the renovation works, which led to the building's closure for three years, the Dona Maria II National Theater reopens its doors this Friday, with a three-day program, an improved house open to everyone - and a play by William Shakespeare that challenges any ghosts and superstitions that haunt this cultural space.

data.title: Peru exige à Rússia informações sobre peruanos recrutados para a guerra
data.description: O ministro dos Negócios Estrangeiros do Peru indicou na quinta-feira ter exigido ao Governo da Rússia, a entrega de informações sobre o paradeiro dos peruanos recrutados para combater ao lado das forças russas na guerra na Ucrânia.
data.translatedTitle: Peru demands information from Russia about Peruvians recruited for war
data.translatedDescription: Peru's Foreign Minister indicated on Thursday that he had demanded that the Russian Government hand over information on the whereabouts of Peruvians recruited to fight alongside Russian forces in the war in Ukraine.

data.title: Câmara dos Deputados da Bolívia aprova acordo de 1,6 MME com o FMI
data.description: A Câmara dos Deputados da Bolívia aprovou na quinta-feira um acordo com o Fundo Monetário Internacional (FMI) de 1,9 mil milhões de dólares (1,6 mil milhões de euros) que apoia reformas económicas no país andino.
data.translatedTitle: Bolivian Chamber of Deputies approves 1.6 MME agreement with the IMF
data.translatedDescription: Bolivia's Chamber of Deputies approved on Thursday an agreement with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) worth 1.9 billion dollars (1.6 billion euros) that supports economic reforms in the Andean country.

data.title: EUA pressionaram Brasil a rever venda de minas de níquel a empresa chinesa
data.description: Os Estados Unidos pressionaram o Brasil a rever a venda de minas de níquel da Anglo American a uma empresa estatal chinesa, em troca de um alívio das tarifas impostas por Washington, avançou hoje um jornal de Hong Kong.
data.translatedTitle: US pressured Brazil to review sale of nickel mines to Chinese company
data.translatedDescription: The United States pressured Brazil to review the sale of Anglo American nickel mines to a Chinese state-owned company, in exchange for relief from tariffs imposed by Washington, a Hong Kong newspaper reported today.

data.title: 6h Jorge Jesus divulga lista de convocados para a Liga das Nações
data.translatedTitle: 6am Jorge Jesus releases squad list for the League of Nations

data.title: Ex-diretor de prisão síria condenado a 60 anos de prisão nos EUA por tortura
data.description: Um antigo diretor de uma prisão de Damasco entre 2005 e 2008 foi condenado a 60 anos de prisão nos Estados Unidos por atos de tortura, anunciou na quinta-feira o Departamento de Justiça norte-americano.
data.translatedTitle: Former Syrian prison director sentenced to 60 years in US prison for torture
data.translatedDescription: A former director of a Damascus prison between 2005 and 2008 was sentenced to 60 years in prison in the United States for acts of torture, the US Department of Justice announced on Thursday.

data.title: Embaixada lusa promove gala "uma mão amiga" a favor dos afetados
data.description: A Embaixada de Portugal em Caracas está a promover uma gala de solidariedade a favor dos afetados do duplo sismo de 24 de junho, que causou danos graves em infraestruturas, feridos e vítimas mortais em sete estados da Venezuela.
data.translatedTitle: Portuguese embassy promotes "a helping hand" gala in favor of those affected
data.translatedDescription: The Embassy of Portugal in Caracas is promoting a solidarity gala in favor of those affected by the double earthquake of June 24, which caused serious damage to infrastructure, injuries and fatalities in seven states in Venezuela.

data.title: China defende "estabilidade estratégica" com EUA antes de eventual visita de Xi
data.description: O ministro dos Negócios Estrangeiros chinês, Wang Yi, afirmou, numa conversa telefónica com o secretário de Estado norte-americano, Marco Rubio, que as relações bilaterais têm avançado recentemente num quadro de "estabilidade estratégica construtiva".
data.translatedTitle: China defends "strategic stability" with the US before Xi's possible visit
data.translatedDescription: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said in a telephone conversation with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio that bilateral relations have recently advanced within a framework of "constructive strategic stability."

data.title: Tentativas de pressão económica dos Estados Unidos "vão fracassar" garante MNE cubano
data.description: O ministro dos Negócios Estrangeiros de Cuba, Bruno Rodríguez, afirmou esta quinta-feira que os Estados Unidos "vão fracassar" na sua pressão contra a ilha após novas sanções contra oito empresas cubanas de exploração mineira e desenvolvimento militar.
data.translatedTitle: Attempts at economic pressure from the United States "will fail" guarantees Cuban Itamaraty
data.translatedDescription: Cuban Foreign Minister Bruno Rodríguez said this Thursday that the United States "will fail" in its pressure against the island following new sanctions against eight Cuban mining and military development companies.

data.title: Inflação no Japão desacelera para 1,7% em agosto
data.description: A inflação homóloga aumentou 1,7% em agosto, assinalando uma ligeira desaceleração do índice de preços no consumidor (IPC) face aos 1,8% registados no mês anterior, informou hoje o Governo nipónico.
data.translatedTitle: Inflation in Japan slows to 1.7% in August
data.translatedDescription: Year-on-year inflation increased by 1.7% in August, signaling a slight deceleration in the consumer price index (IPC) compared to the 1.8% recorded in the previous month, the Japanese Government reported today.

data.title: Oposição venezuelana exige libertação de ex-autarca
data.description: A oposição venezuelana exigiu hoje a libertação imediata de um ex-presidente da câmara detido esta quinta-feira, na mesma altura em que começa a segunda fase do diálogo com o Governo da Presidente interina Delcy Rodríguez.
data.translatedTitle: Venezuelan opposition demands release of former mayor
data.translatedDescription: The Venezuelan opposition today demanded the immediate release of a former mayor arrested this Thursday, at the same time that the second phase of dialogue with the government of interim president Delcy Rodríguez begins.

data.title: EUA acusam Conselho de Direitos Humanos da ONU de "disparates sem sentido"
data.description: A Casa Branca acusou hoje o Conselho de Direitos Humanos da ONU de "proferir disparates sem sentido há décadas", reagindo ao relatório de uma comissão do organismo que atribui aos Estados Unidos crimes de guerra em bombardeamentos no Irão.
data.translatedTitle: US accuses UN Human Rights Council of “senseless nonsense”
data.translatedDescription: The White House today accused the UN Human Rights Council of "spewing senseless nonsense for decades", reacting to the report of a committee of the body that attributes war crimes to the United States in bombings in Iran.
