data.title: UFTF multa a Nasralla con L146 millones por irregularidades en rendición de cuentas
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- La Unidad de Financiamiento, Transparencia y Fiscalización (UFTF) informó que el excandidato presidencial del Partido Liberal, Salvador Nasralla , será sancionado con 146 millones de lempiras debido a irregularidades detectadas en sus informes financieros de campaña de las elecciones generales de 2025. La UFTF explicó que detectaron inconsistencias en la captación de 73 millones de lempiras (73,228,860 exactos) provenientes de 21 aportes privados, los cuales no fueron subsanados en tiempo y forma. En ese sentido, la multa equivale al doble del monto que no pudo subsanar (146,457,720). Nasralla podrá presentar un recurso de apelación ante el Tribunal de Justicia Electoral (TJE) dentro de los tres días hábiles siguientes a su notificación. Aún así, se aclaró que el expresidenciable deberá "tener por presentados de manera extemporánea los formatos correspondientes a las 21 aportaciones únicamente para efectos de incorporación y fiscalización documental sin que dicha presentación posterior extinga la infracción ni la sanción impuesta". La comisionada presidente de la UFTF, Ivonne Ardón, declaró que en su debido momento se le notificó al responsable financiero de Nasralla acerca de los hallazgos e inconsistencias encontradas. "Él presentó su descargo, documentación y un escrito en donde justificaba por qué no se habían hecho ciertos procedimientos que ya la propia ley establece. Una cosa es presentar un informe, y otra es que se cumpla con los parámetros que ya la ley establece", dijo. Agregó que "en base a todos esos hallazgos que no pudieron ser subsanados es que el Pleno determina que se da por recibido en tiempo, mas no conforme, porque hay todavía hallazgos que tienen que ser investigados por el Ministerio Público. Eso ya no nos corresponde a nosotros investigar esos hallazgos que no pudimos como institución verificar". Asimismo, enfatizó que la labor de la UFTF es con base en la información que remiten los candidatos. "Los documentos con los que trabajaron el departamento de auditoría y el departamento de legal, fueron los documentos que su responsable financiero entregó a la unidad", puntualizó. Horas antes, Nasralla publicó un video en sus redes sociales en el que dijo haber sido notificado sobre la resolución que tomó la UFTF, afirmando que se trataba de cuestionamientos administrativos y documentales. A su vez, sostuvo que entregó en tiempo y forma toda la documentación correspondiente a rendición de cuentas de su campaña. Desde su perspectiva, existe una conspiración entre el Partido Nacional y sectores del Partido Liberal que buscan inhabilitarlo de participar en las elecciones de 2029, en las cuales aspira nuevamente a la presidencia de la República y a la presidencia del Consejo Central Ejecutivo del Partido Liberal (CCEPL). "No descarto que detrás de estas actuaciones exista una mano política interesada en sacarme de la competencia. Hay sectores del Partido Nacional y sectores de mi propio Partido Liberal que durante años han tenido intereses comunes. Yo los he cuestionado y lo seguiré cuestionando", expresó. Sobre estas declaraciones de Nasralla, Ardón manifestó que "nosotros no inscribimos ni desinscribimos a nadie. La unidad solamente verifica el origen, uso y destino de los fondos que se invierten en los procesos electorales. En base a eso es que se aplican las sanciones cuando hay incumplimiento".
data.translatedTitle: UFTF multa a Nasralla con L146 millones por irregularidades en rendición de cuentas
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The Financing, Transparency and Supervision Unit (UFTF) reported that the former presidential candidate of the Liberal Party, Salvador Nasralla, will be sanctioned with 146 million lempiras due to irregularities detected in his campaign financial reports for the 2025 general elections. The UFTF explained that they detected inconsistencies in the collection of 73 million lempiras (73,228,860 exactly) coming from 21 private contributions, which were not corrected in a timely manner. In that sense, the fine is equivalent to double the amount that could not be corrected (146,457,720). Nasralla may file an appeal with the Electoral Court of Justice (ECJ) within three business days following his notification. Even so, it was clarified that the former presidential candidate must "have the forms corresponding to the 21 contributions submitted late in the year solely for the purposes of incorporation and documentary inspection without such subsequent presentation extinguishing the infraction or the sanction imposed." The presiding commissioner of the UFTF, Ivonne Ardón, stated that in due course the financial officer of Nasralla was notified about the findings and inconsistencies found. "He presented his defense, documentation and a writing justifying why certain procedures that the law itself established had not been carried out. It is one thing to present a report, and another is to comply with the parameters that the law already establishes," he said. He added that "based on all those findings that could not be corrected, the Plenary determines that it is considered received on time, but not compliant, because there are still findings that have to be investigated by the Public Ministry. That is no longer up to us to investigate those findings that we could not as an institution verify." Likewise, he emphasized that the work of the UFTF is based on the information submitted by the candidates. "The documents with which the audit department and the legal department worked were the documents that their financial manager delivered to the unit," he said. Hours before, Nasralla published a video on his social networks in which he said he had been notified about the resolution taken by the UFTF, stating that it involved administrative and documentary questions. In turn, he maintained that he delivered all the documentation corresponding to the accountability of his campaign in a timely manner. From his perspective, there is a conspiracy between the National Party and sectors of the Liberal Party that seek to disqualify him from participating in the 2029 elections, in which he aspires again to the presidency of the Republic and the presidency of the Central Executive Council of the Liberal Party (CCEPL). "I do not rule out that behind these actions there is a political hand interested in removing me from the competition. There are sectors of the National Party and sectors of my own Liberal Party that for years have had common interests. I have questioned them and will continue to question them," he expressed. Regarding these statements by Nasralla, Ardón stated that "we do not register or unregister anyone. The unit only verifies the origin, use and destination of the funds that are invested in the electoral processes. Based on that, sanctions are applied when there is non-compliance."

data.title: Política Limpia denuncia retiro de protección a sus comisionados durante presentación de informe
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- La comisionada de la Unidad de Financiamiento, Transparencia y Fiscalización ( UFTF ), conocida como Política Limpia, Ivonne Ardón , denunció este jueves que el Estado retiró la protección que tenían asignada los integrantes del pleno de comisionados, situación que, según afirmó, los deja en condición de vulnerabilidad mientras presentan información relacionada con los gastos de campaña electoral. Ardón hizo el señalamiento durante la presentación del informe de fiscalización de los recursos utilizados en las elecciones generales de 2025, proceso que contempla sanciones para candidatos que no cumplieron con las obligaciones de rendición de cuentas establecidas. “Estamos presentando esta información a sabiendas que se nos ha retirado la protección por parte del Estado a los miembros de este honorable pleno de comisionados, lo que nos deja en total vulnerabilidad”, manifestó Ardón. La funcionaria sostuvo que los integrantes de la UFTF conocen los riesgos asociados con las decisiones que adopta el organismo, particularmente cuando se presentan informes que pueden derivar en sanciones o afectaciones económicas para determinadas personas. “Si algo nos llega a suceder por haber presentado este tipo de información, como autoridades conocemos los riesgos, pero también conocemos que el Estado está obligado a brindarle la protección necesaria a sus servidores públicos”, expresó. Ardón afirmó que los integrantes del pleno se sienten amenazados por órganos del Estado que, según su versión, habrían girado instrucciones para retirarles la protección que tenían asignada. “Queremos dejar de manifiesto que este pleno de comisionados se siente amenazado por los propios órganos del Estado que han girado instrucciones para que nos quiten la protección que teníamos asignada”, declaró. Sus declaraciones se producen durante una jornada en la que Política Limpia da a conocer los resultados de la fiscalización de los gastos de campaña, incluidos los expedientes que podrían derivar en sanciones económicas a más de 500 candidatos de elecciones y un excandidato presidencial por el Partido Liberal de Honduras. Durante su intervención, Ardón también se refirió a información que circuló en redes sociales sobre la ausencia del comisionado Julio Mendoza en algunas sesiones del pleno. Según la funcionaria, se habían difundido señalamientos que atribuían la ausencia de Mendoza a una supuesta intención de “planificar” o “boicotear” las decisiones que debe tomar el organismo. Ardón negó esa interpretación y explicó que Mendoza atraviesa actualmente una situación de salud, por lo que pidió respeto para él y su familia. “En este momento nuestro compañero está atendiendo una situación de salud y no podemos dar mayores detalles, pero sí pedimos que se respete la tranquilidad de su familia y la tranquilidad de nuestro compañero, que en este momento se está recuperando”, manifestó. La comisionada evitó brindar detalles sobre la condición de salud de Mendoza y reiteró que su ausencia de las sesiones responde a esa situación.
data.translatedTitle: Política Limpia denuncia retiro de protección a sus comisionados durante presentación de informe
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The commissioner of the Financing, Transparency and Supervision Unit (UFTF), known as Clean Politics, Ivonne Ardón, denounced this Thursday that the State withdrew the protection assigned to the members of the plenary session of commissioners, a situation that, as she stated, leaves them in a vulnerable condition while they present information related to electoral campaign expenses. Ardón made the point during the presentation of the audit report on the resources used in the 2025 general elections, a process that includes sanctions for candidates who did not comply with the established accountability obligations. “We are presenting this information knowing that the State's protection has been withdrawn from the members of this honorable plenary session of commissioners, which leaves us in total vulnerability,” said Ardón. The official maintained that the members of the UFTF know the risks associated with the decisions adopted by the organization, particularly when reports are presented that may lead to sanctions or financial consequences for certain people. “If something happens to us for having presented this type of information, as authorities we know the risks, but we also know that the State is obliged to provide the necessary protection to its public servants,” he said. Ardón stated that the members of the plenary session feel threatened by State bodies that, according to his version, had issued instructions to withdraw the protection assigned to them. “We want to make it clear that this plenary session of commissioners feels threatened by the State bodies themselves that have issued instructions to take away the protection that we had been assigned,” he declared. His statements come during a day in which Clean Politics releases the results of the audit of campaign expenses, including files that could lead to economic sanctions for more than 500 election candidates and a former presidential candidate for the Liberal Party of Honduras. During his speech, Ardón also referred to information that circulated on social networks about the absence of Commissioner Julio Mendoza in some sessions of the plenary session. According to the official, accusations had been spread that attributed Mendoza's absence to an alleged intention to “plan” or “boycott” the decisions that the organization must make. Ardón denied this interpretation and explained that Mendoza is currently going through a health situation, which is why he asked for respect for him and his family. "At this moment our colleague is attending to a health situation and we cannot give further details, but we do ask that the tranquility of his family and the tranquility of our colleague, who is currently recovering, be respected," he said. The commissioner avoided providing details about Mendoza's health condition and reiterated that her absence from the sessions responds to that situation.

data.title: San Sebastián 2026: El talento español busca la gloria dorada tras el adiós de Rebordinos
data.description: San Sebastián, España.- Brad Pitt, Naomi Watts, Penélope Cruz y Ricardo Darín son algunas de las estrellas que pasarán por la alfombra roja del Festival de Cine de San Sebastián , en el norte de España, que arranca este viernes con diecisiete películas a competición por la Concha de Oro -cinco de directoras, una menos que en 2025- y el eco del genocidio en Gaza aún presente. Entre el 18 y el 26 de septiembre, la ciudad será de nuevo uno de los epicentros mundiales del cine -es el único festival español de categoría A, a la altura de Cannes o Venecia- y acogerá la proyección de 263 títulos procedentes de 47 países. Es, además, la última cita bajo la dirección de José Luis Rebordinos, que, tras tres lustros en el cargo, pasa el testigo a una de las actuales subdirectoras, Maialen Beloki, a partir de 2027. El cineasta Ira Sachs preside esta edición un jurado compuesto por el director Genki Kawamura, la guionista Catherine Paillé, las actrices Alice Braga y Patricia López Arnaiz, el actor Bill Skarsgård y el productor Mike Goodridge. Tras el vendaval de Angelina Jolie en la edición de 2025, este año la presencia que despertará más expectación en el Festival es la de su exmarido Brad Pitt, que ya visitó San Sebastián en 2009 para presentar 'Malditos bastardos' junto a Quentin Tarantino. Esta vez acude al certamen con una película de sección oficial fuera de concurso, 'Heart of the Beast', de David Ayer. Los Premios Donostia Werner Herzog y Naomi Watts son otros platos fuertes en el menú de estrellas del certamen, que completan nombres como Orlando Bloom, Marion Cotillard, Penélope Cruz, Ricardo Darín (protagonista del cartel de esta edición), Lali Espósito, Dolores Fonzi, Jeremy Irons, Vincent Lindon, Rami Malek, Noémie Merlant, Mercedes Morán, Lena Olin, Nahuel Pérez Biscayart o Marcelo Subiotto. También presentarán sus películas fuera de concurso directores españoles como Javier Calvo y Javier Ambrossi con 'La bola negra', candidata española en la carrera a los Óscar; Fernando Trueba ('Bajañí') o J.A. Bayona (con la serie documental 'Más allá de la sociedad'). Además, algunos de los últimos triunfadores en Cannes acudirán con sus trabajos: Cristian Mungiu con 'Fjord', Andrey Zvyagintsev con 'Minotauro' y Pawel Pawlikowski con 'Fatherland'. El festival recoge el relevo de Venecia, donde ha sido polémica la escasez de mujeres directoras a concurso, y finalmente ha ganado el León de Oro la única película de una cineasta que concursaba, 'Woman Unknown', de la danesaegipcia May el-Toukhy. Pero en una entrevista con EFE, Rebordinos dijo que no teme las críticas por la bajada de películas dirigidas por mujeres en la sección oficial y que no aboga por cuotas en los festivales, sino por apoyos en la base, en la producción. En concreto, las películas de mujeres cineastas son '7:40 ce matin-là / Milo', de Nicole Garcia (Argelia); 'Muyou no Hito' / 'In My Father’s Room', de Maha Harada (Japón); 'Artakalan' / 'What Remains', de Yeşim Ustaoğlu (Turquía); 'Garrat du váimmu' / 'Brace Your Heart', de Amanda Kernell (Suecia) y 'Krux', de Tony Vahl (Alemania). Ninguna directora española podrá repetir esta edición el triunfo de Alauda Ruiz de Azúa con 'Los domingos' en 2025. Sí lucharán por la Concha de Oro los cineastas españoles Mikel Gurrea ('Sants'), Roberto Bueso ('El mal padre') y Javier Ruiz Caldera ('5 minutos más'). Completan la sección oficial a concurso 'Mis muertos tristes', de Pablo Larraín (Chile); 'Glaxo', de Benjamín Naishtat (Argentina-Brasil); 'Vicentina pede desculpas', de Gabriel Martins (Brasil); 'Tender Loving Care', de Mike Leigh (Reino Unido); 'Geister / Ghost Song', de Fatih Akin (Alemania); 'Markens grøde / Growth of the Soil', de Hans Petter Moland (Noruega); 'Les Misérables', de Frédéric Cavayé (Francia); 'The Debut', de Jesse Eisenberg (Estados Unidos); y 'Biang jing / Border', de Ah Biao (Hong Kong). Aunque ya no ocupa tantas portadas como el año pasado, cuando se proyectó en San Sebastián 'La voz de Hind', la intervención militar de Israel en Gaza seguirá presente con 'NAZA', el documental que muestra la estrategia de Israel para destruir la Franja. El ministro israelí de Cultura ha anunciado que trabajará para intenta revocar la nacionalidad a los directores del documental, que recibió el Premio Especial del Jurado del Festival de Venecia, Yuval Abraham y Rachel Szor.

data.title: UFTF revela que 556 candidatos de las elecciones 2025 no rindieron cuentas
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- La Unidad de Financiamiento, Transparencia y Fiscalización (UFTF) reveló este jueves 17 de septiembre que 556 candidatos que participaron en las elecciones generales de 2025 no presentaron sus informes financieros. De 2,116 sujetos obligados a rendir cuentas en tiempo y forma, 1,560 presentaron sus informes, equivalente a un cumplimiento del 74%. Por nivel electivo, los cinco candidatos presidenciales sí entregaron sus estados financieros. En cuanto a los 682 aspirantes a diputados, cumplieron 508 (74.5%) y otros 174 (25.5%) no lo hicieron. Con respecto a los 1,429 candidatos de las corporaciones municipales, 1,047 presentaron sus informes (73.3%), contrario a 382 que incumplieron (26.7%). Los candidatos del Partido Nacional, Partido Liberal y Libertad y Refundación (Libre) tuvieron un nivel de cumplimiento superior al 85%. El partido Democracia Cristiana fue el que menos cumplimiento tuvo. De 389 aspirantes, solo 96 presentaron sus reportes financieros. Esto equivale en un cumplimiento de apenas 25%. En cuanto al Partido Innovación, de sus 411 candidatos, 285 cumplieron con la normativa. Es decir, el 69% de ellos. De los 427 ciudadanos que fueron electos en los diferentes cargos de elección pública, 14 de ellos no presentaron sus informes, tratándose de 10 alcaldes y cuatro diputados. De estos, cuatro son del Partido Liberal y 10 del Partido Nacional. Los liberales que incumplieron son: José Luis Chevez Mendoza (alcalde de Alubarén/Francisco Morazán), Carlos Gómez Marín (alcalde de Brus Laguna/Gracias a Dios), Gerardo Antonio Mejía Mejía (alcalde de San Marcos/Ocotepeque) y Alberto Emilio Cruz Zelaya (diputado por Comayagua). Respecto a los nacionalistas, fueron identificados: Sheldon Lenin Ávila Salinas (alcalde de Limón/Colón), Óscar Enrique Contreras Benítez (alcalde de Dulce Nombre/Copán), Raúl Alfredo Ugarte Florentino (alcalde de Pimienta/Cortés), Rollin Dion Kelly Hurlston (alcalde de Guanaja/Islas de la Bahía), Marvin Samuel Espinoza Núñez (alcalde de San Pedro de Tutule/La Paz), J. Andrés Gutiérrez Pérez (alcalde de Nuevo Celilac/Santa Bárbara), Daisy María Andonie López (diputada de Cortés), Gustavo Adolfo González Aguilar (diputado de El Paraíso) Sterling Lucas Lucas (alcalde de José Santos Guardiola/Islas de la Bahía) y Stephen Garrett García Arch (diputado de Islas de la Bahía). Las sanciones a los 174 candidatos a diputados, entre electos y no electos, suman un monto de 24.3 millones de lempiras. Cada diputado debe pagar una multa de 10 salarios mínimos. Por otro lado, las sanciones para los alcaldes son de cinco salarios mínimos. Al haber 382 aspirantes que incumplieron, la suma de las sanciones asciende a los 26.7 millones de lempiras. La fecha inicial en la que debían entregar sus reportes era hasta el 15 de diciembre de 2025, pero se aprobó una ampliación mediante el decreto legislativo 41-2026 para que los más de 2 mil candidatos rindieran cuentas hasta el 30 de abril de este año. Cabe recordar que los más de 2 mil candidatos políticos tuvieron hasta el 30 de abril de este año para presentar sus informes financieros a la UFTF. Por otro lado, los comisionados de la UFTF informaron que se aplicará una sanción contra el excandidato presidencial del Partido Liberal, Salvador Nasralla, debido a inconsistencias en los informes que presentó. El argumento se debe a que se detectaron irregularidades en 21 aportaciones privadas que suman más de 73 millones de lempiras. En ese sentido, la multa aplicada será de 146 millones, es decir, el doble del monto.

data.title: Gabriela Castellanos sobre informe del UFTF: Estamos ansiosos de conocerlo
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- La directora ejecutiva del Consejo Nacional Anticorrupción ( CNA ), Gabriela Castellanos, reaccionó este jueves 17 de septiembre al anuncio del informe de la Unidad de Financiamiento, Transparencia y Fiscalización ( UFTF ), conocida como Política Limpia , que contempla sanciones contra políticos por presuntas irregularidades en la justificación de fondos utilizados durante campañas electorales. Castellanos manifestó que desde el CNA esperaban conocer el informe y aseguró que la organización está preparada para analizar la información y actuar conforme a sus atribuciones legales. “Estamos ansiosos de conocer ese informe que sin duda no cabe en el mejor momento, porque desde hace meses estamos esperando este trabajo de Política Limpia. Desde el CNA estamos listos para conocer esta información y desde el CNA actuar conforme a ley”, expresó. Las declaraciones se produjeron horas previas a la presentación del documento de Política Limpia, organismo encargado de fiscalizar el financiamiento, la transparencia y la rendición de cuentas de los recursos utilizados en las campañas políticas. El informe contempla sanciones contra políticos por presuntas irregularidades relacionadas con la justificación de fondos de campaña. Las medidas han generado cuestionamientos sobre el alcance de las acciones y sus posibles implicaciones en el ámbito político. Ante las consultas sobre si las acciones de Política Limpia podrían responder a una persecución política, Castellanos señaló que primero deben revisarse las evidencias que sustentan el informe antes de emitir una conclusión. “¿Persecución política? Yo creo que hay que ver las evidencias con las que se está presentando el día de hoy este informe. Me gusta poder leerlo y luego saber si es una persecución política o la institucionalidad”, manifestó. La directora del CNA insistió en la importancia de conocer el contenido del documento y las pruebas que respaldan las acciones anunciadas por la unidad de fiscalización. Castellanos cerró con una frase sobre el papel que, a su criterio, está desempeñando la institucionalidad en este proceso: “Tarde, pero está funcionando”.
data.translatedTitle: Gabriela Castellanos sobre informe del UFTF: Estamos ansiosos de conocerlo
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The executive director of the National Anti-Corruption Council (CNA), Gabriela Castellanos, reacted this Thursday, September 17, to the announcement of the report of the Financing, Transparency and Supervision Unit (UFTF), known as Clean Politics, which contemplates sanctions against politicians for alleged irregularities in the justification of funds used during electoral campaigns. Castellanos stated that the CNA expected to know the report and assured that the organization is prepared to analyze the information and act in accordance with its legal powers. "We are eager to know this report that undoubtedly does not fit at the best time, because for months we have been waiting for this Clean Policy work. From the ANC we are ready to know this information and from the ANC to act in accordance with the law," he expressed. The statements occurred hours before the presentation of the Clean Policy document, the body in charge of overseeing the financing, transparency and accountability of resources used in political campaigns. The report contemplates sanctions against politicians for alleged irregularities related to the justification of campaign funds. The measures have raised questions about the scope of the actions and their possible implications in the political sphere. When asked about whether the Clean Policy actions could respond to political persecution, Castellanos pointed out that the evidence supporting the report must first be reviewed before issuing a conclusion. data.title: Salvador Nasralla: "Lo que quieren hacer es inhabilitarme políticamente"
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- El excandidato presidencial del Partido Liberal, Salvador Nasralla, aseveró que hay una conspiración para evitar que vuelva a postularse para las elecciones de 2029, esto luego de recibir una notificación de parte de la Unidad de Financiamiento, Transparencia y Fiscalización (UFTF) relacionada con la rendición de cuentas de su campaña política en 2025. El expresidenciable afirmó que presentó su informe en tiempo y forma con toda la documentación correspondiente. "Aquí no existe una sentencia que diga que Salvador Nasralla se robó algún centavo o que Salvador Nasralla se apropió del dinero de una campaña o que malversó fondos", puntualizó. Mencionó que en la notificación que recibió se le informó sobre cuestionamientos administrativos y documentales, los cuales serán litigados por su equipo legal. A su criterio, hay un complot en su contra a raíz de sus aspiraciones políticas y de presidir el Consejo Central Ejecutivo del Partido Liberal (CCEPL). "No descarto que detrás de estas actuaciones exista una mano política interesada en sacarme de la competencia. Hay sectores del Partido Nacional y sectores de mi propio Partido Liberal que durante años han tenido intereses comunes. Yo los he cuestionado y lo seguiré cuestionando", dijo. Opinó que "en el fondo, lo que quieren hacer es inhabilitarme políticamente para que yo no pueda participar en las elecciones de 2029. Y les vuelvo a preguntar: ¿Cuál es el miedo?", cuestionando por qué, cuando decide participar en elecciones, "aparecen obstáculos" que buscan apartarlo de la competencia. Con respecto a la notificación de la UFTF, aseguró que no desistirá de sus aspiraciones y que se defenderá jurídicamente. Además, comentó que pretenden imponerle una sanción, pero argumentó que el "reglamento que fue creado específicamente para las elecciones de 2017, el cual ya no se encuentra vigente. Por lo tanto, después de todo lo que puedan investigar, no será aplicable ninguna multa". "No busco impunidad, exijo legalidad. No busco privilegios, exijo igualdad ante la ley. Y a quienes puedan tener miedo de que lleguemos a cambiar las viejas prácticas de la política hondureña, les voy a decir palabras sencillas: no me van a sacar de la competencia mediante presiones ni expedientes como el que recibí ayer", enfatizó. La UFTF adelantó que este jueves 17 de septiembre presentará su informe sobre candidatos políticos y corrientes que no entregaron sus reportes de estados financieros y respaldos de egresos correspondientes a los comicios del año pasado. Entre los candidatos que serían multados, figura un excandidato a la presidencia de la República por el Partido Liberal.
data.translatedTitle: Salvador Nasralla: "Lo que quieren hacer es inhabilitarme políticamente"
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The former presidential candidate of the Liberal Party, Salvador Nasralla, asserted that there is a conspiracy to prevent him from running again for the 2029 elections, this after receiving a notification from the Financing, Transparency and Oversight Unit (UFTF) related to the accountability of his political campaign in 2025. The former presidential candidate stated that he presented his report in a timely manner with all the corresponding documentation. "Here there is no sentence that says that Salvador Nasralla stole a penny or that Salvador Nasralla appropriated money from a campaign or that he embezzled funds," he pointed out. He mentioned that in the notification he received he was informed about administrative and documentary questions, which will be litigated by his legal team. In his opinion, there is a plot against him as a result of his political aspirations and his presidency of the Central Executive Council of the Liberal Party (CCEPL). "I do not rule out that behind these actions there is a political hand interested in removing me from the competition. There are sectors of the National Party and sectors of my own Liberal Party that for years have had common interests. I have questioned them and will continue to question them," he said. He said that "deep down, what they want to do is disqualify me politically so that I cannot participate in the 2029 elections. And I ask you again: What is the fear?", questioning why, when you decide to participate in elections, "obstacles appear" that seek to separate you from the competition. Regarding the UFTF notification, he assured that he will not give up his aspirations and that he will defend himself legally. In addition, he commented that they intend to impose a sanction, but argued that the "regulations that were created specifically for the 2017 elections, which are no longer in force. Therefore, after everything they can investigate, no fine will be applicable." "I do not seek impunity, I demand legality. I do not seek privileges, I demand equality before the law. And to those who may be afraid that we will change the old practices of Honduran politics, I am going to tell them simple words: they are not going to remove me from the competition through pressure or files like the one I received yesterday," he emphasized. The UFTF announced that this Thursday, September 17, it will present its report on political and current candidates who did not submit their financial statement reports and support for expenditures corresponding to last year's elections. Among the candidates who would be fined is a former candidate for the presidency of the Republic for the Liberal Party.

data.title: Marcia Facussé responde a supuestos chats que la vinculan con acciones contra Salvador Nasralla
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- La difusión de supuestos chats atribuidos a miembros del Partido Liberal, en los que se plantean posibles acciones contra Salvador Nasralla, generó reacciones entre dirigentes de esa organización política. En las conversaciones que circulan en redes sociales aparecen nombres de figuras vinculadas al liberalismo y se plantean, según las publicaciones difundidas, posibles acciones legales y estrategias relacionadas con Nasralla. Ante la difusión del material, Marcia Facussé , secretaria de comunicaciones del Consejo Central Ejecutivo del Partido Liberal ( CCEPL ), emitió un comunicado en el que cuestionó que una captura de pantalla pueda utilizarse como prueba de su participación en una conversación. “Una captura de pantalla no acredita la participación de una persona en una conversación”, señaló Facussé. La dirigente también sostuvo que la aparición de un contacto identificado con determinado nombre no demuestra quién utiliza realmente el número ni permite establecer, por sí sola, la autenticidad o integridad del contenido difundido. Facussé agregó que ha conocido versiones sobre la posible divulgación de un supuesto audio y video relacionado con el mismo tema y anticipó que rechazaría cualquier material que considere falso o manipulado. En su pronunciamiento, la dirigente liberal también hizo referencia a la incorporación de Salvador Nasralla al Partido Liberal. Facussé afirmó que hace más de dos años promovió la incorporación de personas provenientes de otros partidos al instituto político, entre ellas Nasralla, con el propósito que, según expresó, era fortalecer al Partido Liberal. De acuerdo con su versión, la llegada de Nasralla terminó generando parte de las diferencias internas que actualmente enfrenta esa organización. Facusse también señaló que la atención debería centrarse en un informe de la Unidad de Financiamiento, Transparencia y Fiscalización (UFTF) relacionado con el manejo de fondos de campaña y pidió que cualquier señalamiento sobre posibles irregularidades sea investigado y que se respete el debido proceso. “Como liberal, exijo que las irregularidades sean esclarecidas, que se respete el debido proceso y que se investigue a fondo”, manifestó. El tema se conoce en medio de las diferencias internas que atraviesa el Partido Liberal y mientras se espera la divulgación del informe de la Unidad de Política Limpia, que permitirá conocer el manejo de recursos vinculados a la campaña presidencial de Salvador Nasralla. Según lo expuesto, la documentación requerida para justificar entre 40 y 70 millones de lempiras no habría sido presentada de manera satisfactoria. Será hasta la presentación oficial del documento cuando se podrá establecer si los montos señalados corresponden a la campaña de Nasralla, cuáles son las inconsistencias detectadas y quiénes aparecen vinculados en los hallazgos. El expediente será remitido a las autoridades correspondientes, que deberán determinar si existen responsabilidades administrativas a partir de la documentación revisada.
data.translatedTitle: Marcia Facussé responde a supuestos chats que la vinculan con acciones contra Salvador Nasralla

In the conversations circulating on social networks, names of figures linked to liberalism appear and, according to the published publications, possible legal actions and strategies related to Nasralla are proposed. Given the dissemination of the material, Marcia Facussé, communications secretary of the Central Executive Council of the Liberal Party (CCEPL), issued a statement in which she questioned whether a screenshot could be used as proof of her participation in a conversation. “A screenshot does not prove a person's participation in a conversation,” said Facussé. The leader also maintained that the appearance of a contact identified with a certain name does not prove who actually uses the number nor does it allow us to establish, by itself, the authenticity or integrity of the content disseminated. Facussé added that he has learned of versions about the possible disclosure of an alleged audio and video related to the same topic and anticipated that he would reject any material that he considers false or manipulated. In her statement, the liberal leader also made reference to the incorporation of Salvador Nasralla into the Liberal Party. Facussé stated that more than two years ago he promoted the incorporation of people from other parties to the political institute, among them Nasralla, with the purpose that, as he expressed, was to strengthen the Liberal Party. According to his version, Nasralla's arrival ended up generating part of the internal differences that that organization currently faces. Facusse also noted that attention should focus on a report from the Financing, Transparency and Oversight Unit (UFTF) related to the management of campaign funds and requested that any allegations of possible irregularities be investigated and that due process be respected. “As a liberal, I demand that the irregularities be clarified, that due process be respected and that it be thoroughly investigated,” he said. The issue is known in the midst of the internal differences that the Liberal Party is going through and while waiting for the release of the Clean Policy Unit report, which will allow us to know the management of resources linked to Salvador Nasralla's presidential campaign. According to the above, the documentation required to justify between 40 and 70 million lempiras would not have been presented satisfactorily. It will not be until the official presentation of the document when it will be possible to establish whether the amounts indicated correspond to Nasralla's campaign, what inconsistencies are detected and who appears linked in the findings. The file will be sent to the corresponding authorities, who must determine if there are administrative responsibilities based on the reviewed documentation.

data.title: Ángela Mariel Moya: Futura periodista y palillona de excelencia
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- Ángela Mariel Moya conserva —incluso en la calma de la sala de redacción de EL HERALDO— la misma seguridad que exhibió frente al público durante los desfiles patrios, con su uniforme, una pieza de corte marcial en negro con vistosos apliques dorados, hombreras de fleco y un quepí rematado en plumas oscuras, silueta que remite a la estética clásica de las palillonas hondureñas con un guiño contemporáneo en sus terminaciones metálicas. La joven de 17 años cursa el duodécimo grado de Bachillerato Técnico Profesional en Informática en el Instituto Mary de Flores , y fue esa dualidad, la de estudiante de excelencia académica y palillona destacada , la que la llevó a protagonizar la portada de ayer. “Me sentí muy alegre y orgullosa de representar a mi instituto”, dice sobre ese reconocimiento, y esa alegría es la que acompaña el resto de la conversación. Es su segundo año desfilando como palillona. ¿Por qué tomó la decisión de volver a participar? El año pasado fue mi primera vez como palillona. Siento que no di mi 100% al estar un poco insegura. Pero este año lo di todo, sonreí, posé a las cámaras y me siento muy alegre del resultado. ¿Cómo fueron sus primeros ensayos? ¿Se le dificultaban los pasos? Sí, en realidad yo nunca fui mucho de bailar. Entonces, al inicio lo que se me dificultaba fue la punta. Como toda catracha debería haberla aprendido desde antes, pero sí se me complicaba un poco. ¿Qué considera que es lo más difícil de ser palillona? La sincronización del grupo entero, porque no solo es hacer los pasos, sino sincronizarse con las compañeras y con la capitana. Más allá de esta faceta, ¿qué hace en sus tiempos libres? Además de dedicarme a mis estudios, me gusta dibujar, ver alguna serie, entretenerme y hacer manualidades. ¿Qué le diría a una niña o joven que sueña con ser palillona? Que den todo de ellas, que nunca esperen hasta el día del desfile. Practiquen su sonrisa desde los inicios de los ensayos y denlo todo. ¿Qué quiere hacer cuando se gradúe del colegio? ¿Qué planea estudiar? Planeo estudiar una licenciatura en periodismo. Me interesa mucho y me gustaría ser periodista, hablar en las redes y demás. Para finalizar, ¿un mensaje para su familia y para quienes la apoyaron en todo este proceso? Les quiero dar gracias a todos. Me siento muy alegre, esos mensajes de amor y cariño me hacen muy feliz. Gracias por apoyarme todo el tiempo. .
data.translatedTitle: Ángela Mariel Moya: Futura periodista y palillona de excelencia
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- Ángela Mariel Moya preserves—even in the calm of the EL HERALDO newsroom—the same confidence that she exhibited in front of the public during the national parades, with her uniform, a black martial court piece with colorful gold appliqués, fringed shoulder pads and a kepi finished in dark feathers, a silhouette that refers to the classic aesthetic of the Honduran palillonas with a contemporary nod in its metallic finishes. The 17-year-old girl is in her twelfth year of Professional Technical Baccalaureate in Computer Science at the Mary de Flores Institute, and it was that duality, that of a student of academic excellence and an outstanding palillona, ​​that led her to star on yesterday's cover. “I felt very happy and proud to represent my institute,” she says about that recognition, and that joy is what accompanies the rest of the conversation. It is his second year parading as a palillona. Why did you make the decision to participate again? Last year was my first time as a palillona. I feel like I didn't give my 100% because I was a little insecure. But this year I gave it my all, I smiled, I posed for the cameras and I feel very happy about the result. What were your first rehearsals like? Were your steps difficult? Yes, actually I was never much of a dancer. So, at the beginning what was difficult for me was the tip. Like any catracha I should have learned it before, but it did get a little complicated for me. What do you consider to be the most difficult thing about being a palillona? The synchronization of the entire group, because it is not only doing the steps, but also synchronizing with the teammates and the captain. Beyond this facet, what do you do in your free time? In addition to dedicating myself to my studies, I like to draw, watch series, entertain myself and do crafts. What would you say to a girl or young woman who dreams of being a palillona? Let them give their all, never wait until the day of the parade. Practice your smile from the beginning of rehearsals and give it your all. What do you want to do when you graduate from school? What do you plan to study? I plan to study a degree in journalism. I am very interested and I would like to be a journalist, speak on the networks and so on. Finally, a message for your family and for those who supported you throughout this process? I want to thank you all. I feel very happy, those messages of love and affection make me very happy. Thank you for supporting me all the time. .

data.title: Meloni upozorava: Putin traži eskalaciju s Evropom kako bi prikrio neuspjehe u Ukrajini
data.description: Italijanska premijerka Giorgia Meloni izjavila je u Oslu da Vladimir Putin pokušava pojačati tenzije s Evropom kako bi skrenuo pažnju s ratišta u Ukrajini.
data.translatedTitle: Meloni warns: Putin seeks escalation with Europe to cover up failures in Ukraine
data.translatedDescription: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said in Oslo that Vladimir Putin is trying to increase tensions with Europe in order to divert attention from the battlefield in Ukraine.

data.title: Legendarni Del Piero oduševljen Alajbegovićem: Kerim izgleda kao ozbiljan talent za svoje godine
data.description: Legenda Juventusa Alessandro Del Piero podijelio je svoje utiske nakon što je torinski klub u okviru Evropske lige deklasirao nizozemski NEC Nijmegen impresivnim rezultatom 5:0, a tom prilikom je pohvalio i Kerima Alajbegovića koji je na tom susretu postigao prvijenac u dresu Stare dame.
data.translatedTitle: The legendary Del Piero is delighted with Alajbegović: Kerim looks like a serious talent for his age
data.translatedDescription: Juventus legend Alessandro Del Piero shared his impressions after the Turin club outclassed the Dutch NEC Nijmegen in the European League with an impressive score of 5:0, and on that occasion he also praised Kerim Alajbegović, who made his debut in the Old Lady shirt at that meeting.

data.title: Član DF-a podnio krivičnu prijavu protiv Staše Košarca zbog veličanja ratnog zločinca  Ratka Mladića
data.description: Kandidat Demokratske fronte (DF) za Skupštinu Kantona Sarajevo Davud Bećirović podnio je Tužilaštvu Bosne i Hercegovine krivičnu prijavu protiv ministra vanjske trgovine i ekonomskih odnosa BiH Staše Košarca, zbog, kako se navodi u prijavi, sumnje da je počinio krivično djelo izazivanja nacionalne, rasne i vjerske mržnje, razdora i netrpeljivosti.
data.translatedTitle: A member of the DF filed a criminal complaint against Staša Košarac for glorifying the war criminal Ratko Mladić
data.translatedDescription: The candidate of the Democratic Front (DF) for the Sarajevo Canton Assembly, Davud Bećirović, filed a criminal complaint with the Prosecutor's Office of Bosnia and Herzegovina against the Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Relations of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Staša Košarac, because, as stated in the complaint, he is suspected of having committed the criminal offense of inciting national, racial and religious hatred, discord and intolerance.

data.title: Policija uhapsila muškarca iz Tuzle, terete ga da je pomagao prijatelju nakon brutalnog ubistva brata
data.description: Istražitelji Uprave policije MUP-a Tuzlanskog kantona uhapsili su 33-godišnjeg H. K. iz Tuzle zbog sumnje da je pomagao počiniocu nakon ubistva koje se dogodilo početkom maja ove godine, kada je E. S. (1982) usmrtio svog brata E. S. (1986).
data.translatedTitle: The police arrested a man from Tuzla, accusing him of helping a friend after the brutal murder of his brother
data.translatedDescription: Investigators of the Tuzla Canton MUP Police Department arrested 33-year-old H. K. from Tuzla on suspicion of helping the perpetrator after the murder that took place at the beginning of May this year, when E. S. (1982) killed his brother E. S. (1986).

data.title: Nogometašice Nürnberga odgovorile Sydney Sweeney zbog golišave reklame: Je***o začepi
data.description: Reakcije na reklamu američke glumice Sydney Sweeney u kojoj pozira gola se ne stišavaju, a dobila je odgovor i od ženske nogometne ekipe Nürnberga gdje su joj u videu na Instagramu poručili da "začepi".
data.translatedTitle: Nürnberg soccer players responded to Sydney Sweeney for a nude advertisement: Shut up
data.translatedDescription: Reactions to the advertisement of the American actress Sydney Sweeney in which she poses naked are not slowing down, and she also received a response from the women's football team of Nuremberg, where they told her to "shut up" in a video on Instagram.

data.title: Počinje izdavanje viza za vozače iz BiH: Od 23. septembra zahtjevi se mogu podnijeti u Hrvatskoj
data.description: Profesionalni vozači iz Bosne i Hercegovine će od 23. septembra moći podnositi zahtjeve za izdavanje vize u Republici Hrvatskoj, u skladu s izmjenama hrvatskog Zakona o strancima koje se odnose na ovu kategoriju radnika.
data.translatedTitle: Issuance of visas for drivers from Bosnia and Herzegovina begins: From September 23, applications can be submitted in Croatia
data.translatedDescription: From September 23, professional drivers from Bosnia and Herzegovina will be able to submit visa applications in the Republic of Croatia, in accordance with the amendments to the Croatian Law on Foreigners that refer to this category of workers.

data.title: Inspiracija za Mitsuokin roadster LA1 bio je model C1 Corvette
data.description: Kompanija Mitsuoka je objavila nove fotografije i informacije o svom roadsteru s dva sjedišta. Mitsuoka LA1 spaja dizajn modela Chevrolet Corvette C1 s modernom mehanikom Mazde MX-5 ND sa stražnjim pogonom.
data.translatedTitle: The inspiration for Mitsubishi's LA1 roadster was the C1 Corvette model
data.translatedDescription: Mitsuoka has released new photos and information about its two-seater roadster. The Mitsuoka LA1 combines the design of the Chevrolet Corvette C1 with the modern mechanics of the rear-wheel drive Mazda MX-5 ND.

data.title: Milionska ulaganja u zaštitu od poplava u Hadžićima, Pazariću i Tarčinu
data.description: Ministar privrede Kantona Sarajevo Zlatko Mijatović i načelnik Općine Hadžići Eldar Čomor obišli su radove na regulaciji rijeke Zujevine u centru Hadžića. Riječ je o jednom od pet projekata uređenja vodotoka koji se realizuju na području ove općine uz finansijsku podršku Ministarstva privrede KS.
data.translatedTitle: Millions of investments in flood protection in Hadžići, Pazarić and Tarčin
data.translatedDescription: The Minister of Economy of the Sarajevo Canton, Zlatko Mijatović, and the Mayor of the Municipality of Hadžići, Eldar Čomor, visited the works on the regulation of the Zujevina River in the center of Hadžići. This is one of the five watercourse improvement projects that are being implemented in the area of ​​this municipality with the financial support of the Ministry of Economy of the KS.

data.title: Historijski rekord Svjetske banke: U 2026. godini mobilizirano nevjerovatnih 112 milijardi dolara
data.description: Grupacija Svjetske banke mobilizirala je tokom fiskalne 2026. godine rekordnih 112 milijardi američkih dolara privatnog kapitala, što je najveći godišnji iznos u njenoj historiji.
data.translatedTitle: Historical record of the World Bank: In 2026, an incredible 112 billion dollars was mobilized
data.translatedDescription: The World Bank Group mobilized a record US$112 billion in private capital during fiscal year 2026, the largest annual amount in its history.

data.title: Indonezija besplatno od Italije dobila svoj prvi nosač aviona, ali je star 41 godinu
data.description: Indonezija je u petak u vojnoj bazi u luci Tanjung Priok u sjevernoj Jakarti dočekala svoj prvi nosač aviona, bivši italijanski brod ITS Giuseppe Garibaldi, koji će naredne sedmice biti uveden u flotu.
data.translatedTitle: Indonesia got its first aircraft carrier from Italy for free, but it is 41 years old
data.translatedDescription: Indonesia on Friday welcomed its first aircraft carrier, the former Italian ship ITS Giuseppe Garibaldi, to a military base in the port of Tanjung Priok in North Jakarta, which will be inducted into the fleet next week.

data.title: Kinezi pokrenuli fabriku koja može proizvesti humanoidnog robota svakih 10 minuta
data.description: Kineska kompanija UBTECH pustila je u rad pogon u Liuzhouu koji bi prema planovima, mogao godišnje proizvoditi više od 10.000 humanoidnih robota.
data.translatedTitle: The Chinese have launched a factory that can produce a humanoid robot every 10 minutes
data.translatedDescription: The Chinese company UBTECH has put into operation a plant in Liuzhou which, according to plans, could annually produce more than 10,000 humanoid robots.

data.title: Saudijska Arabija preko Omana ponudila Hutima prekid vatre i direktne pregovore
data.description: Saudijska Arabija je preko Sultanata Oman prenijela novi prijedlog jemenskim Hutima, koji uključuje dvosedmični prekid vatre i otvaranje direktnih razgovora između Rijada i rukovodstva Huta.
data.translatedTitle: Saudi Arabia through Oman offered the Houthis a ceasefire and direct negotiations
data.translatedDescription: Saudi Arabia has conveyed a new proposal to Yemen's Houthis through the Sultanate of Oman, which includes a two-week ceasefire and the opening of direct talks between Riyadh and the Houthi leadership.

data.title: Veliki predizborni skup Koalicije NES-a, PDA i Naprijed! u Tuzli:  Nije dovoljno samo voljeti BiH
data.description: U Tuzli je sinoć održan predizborni skup koalicije NES BiH, PDA i Naprijed! - Za evropsku BiH zajedno, na kojem su predstavljeni kandidati i programski prioriteti ove političke grupacije.

data.translatedDescription: In Tuzla, a pre-election meeting of the coalition NES BiH, PDA and Naprijed! was held last night. - For a European BiH together, at which the candidates and program priorities of this political grouping were presented.

data.title: Centralna izborna komisija s američkom firmom potpisala ugovor težak 660.000 KM za nezavisnu reviziju izbornih tehnologija
data.description: Centralna izborna komisija Bosne i Hercegovine potpisala je 18. septembra 2026. u Sarajevu ugovor za nabavku usluge nezavisne verifikacije, validacije i revizije izbornih tehnologija.
data.translatedTitle: The Central Election Commission signed a 660,000 KM contract with an American company for an independent audit of election technologies.
data.translatedDescription: On September 18, 2026, the Central Election Commission of Bosnia and Herzegovina signed a contract for the procurement of the service of independent verification, validation and audit of election technologies in Sarajevo.

data.title: James McAvoy u mladosti želio postati svećenik: Kada sam počeo razmišljati o djevojkama, to je nekako nestalo
data.description: Glumac James McAvoy nedavno je otkrio da je u djetinjstvu imao želju da se posveti religiji i postane svećenik.
data.translatedTitle: James McAvoy wanted to become a priest in his youth: When I started thinking about girls, it kind of disappeared
data.translatedDescription: Actor James McAvoy recently revealed that as a child he had a desire to devote himself to religion and become a priest.

data.title: Počela sanacija klizišta u Milinkladskoj ulici u Novom Sarajevu
data.description: Na području Općine Novo Sarajevo započeli su radovi na sanaciji klizišta u ulici Milinkladska 167, čime je počela realizacija projekta čiji je cilj stabilizacija terena i povećanje sigurnosti stanovnika i objekata na ovom lokalitetu.
data.translatedTitle: Remediation of the landslide in Milinkladska Street in Novo Sarajevo has begun
data.translatedDescription: In the territory of the Municipality of Novo Sarajevo, work began on the rehabilitation of the landslide in Milinkladska Street 167, which started the implementation of the project whose goal is to stabilize the terrain and increase the safety of residents and buildings in this locality.

data.title: Lucid se udružuje s Boltom, imat će 25.000 robotaksija na evropskim cestama
data.description: Kompanija Bolt za usluge prijevoza posluje u više od 850 gradova u 50 zemalja, a sada udružuje snage s Lucidom kako bi poslala hiljade robotaksija na ulice Starog kontinenta.
data.translatedTitle: Lucid teams up with Bolt, will have 25,000 robot taxis on European roads
data.translatedDescription: The ride-hailing company Bolt operates in more than 850 cities in 50 countries, and is now joining forces with Lucida to send thousands of robot taxis to the streets of the Old Continent.

data.title: Jubilarni Simposar počinje danas, gosti brojni poznati sportisti
data.description: Jubilarno, 15. izdanje Međunarodne sportske konferencije Simposar počinje danas u Sarajevu u Swissotelu i trajat će do nedjelje, a centralna zvijezda ovogodišnjeg programa je legendarna američka atletičarka Jackie Joyner-Kersee.
data.translatedTitle: The Jubilee Symposar starts today, with the guests of many famous sportsmen
data.translatedDescription: The jubilee, 15th edition of the Simposar International Sports Conference starts today in Sarajevo at the Swissotel and will last until Sunday, and the central star of this year's program is the legendary American athlete Jackie Joyner-Kersee.

data.title: Danas obustave saobraćaja zbog utakmice na stadionu Grbavica
data.description: U Sarajevu će danas, zbog održavanja fudbalske utakmice između FK Željezničar i NK Čelik, doći do obustave saobraćaja od 17 do 23 sati.
data.translatedTitle: Traffic is suspended today due to the match at the Grbavica stadium
data.translatedDescription: In Sarajevo today, due to the football match between FK Željezničar and NK Čelik, there will be a suspension of traffic from 17:00 to 23:00.

data.title: Toyota predstavila DKR GR FC Hilux za Dakar Rally 2027
data.description: Gazoo Racing je objavio prve fotografije prototipa novog DKR GR FC Hiluxa, koji će se takmičiti na reliju Dakar 2027. godine u Saudijskoj Arabiji. Ovaj automobil umjesto motora s unutrašnjim sagorijevanjem koristi sistem s vodikovim gorivnim ćelijama te služi kao testna platforma za buduće serijske modele.
data.translatedTitle: Toyota presented the DKR GR FC Hilux for the 2027 Dakar Rally
data.translatedDescription: Gazoo Racing has released the first prototype photos of the new DKR GR FC Hilux, which will compete in the 2027 Dakar Rally in Saudi Arabia. This car uses a hydrogen fuel cell system instead of an internal combustion engine and serves as a test platform for future production models.

data.title: Novi iPhone 18 srušio sve rekorde u Kini: Na stotine ljudi u redovima ispred prodavnica
data.description: Iako rani pokazatelji u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama (SAD) ukazuju na blago razočaravajuću potražnju, Apple s novim modelima iPhone 18 Pro i iPhone 18 Pro Max bilježi ogroman uspjeh u Kini, obarajući rekorde koje je prošle godine postavio iPhone 17 Pro.
data.translatedTitle: The new iPhone 18 broke all records in China: Hundreds of people lined up in front of stores
data.translatedDescription: Although early indicators in the United States of America (USA) indicate a slightly disappointing demand, Apple with the new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max models is experiencing huge success in China, breaking the records set by the iPhone 17 Pro last year.

data.title: Pet znakova da vaše tijelo ne podnosi dobro kafu
data.description: Za mnoge ljude kafa je nezaobilazan dio jutarnje rutine. Šolja kafe može pomoći da se razbudimo, povećamo budnost i lakše započnemo dan. Ipak, ne reaguje svako tijelo na kofein na isti način.
data.translatedTitle: Five signs that your body does not tolerate coffee well
data.translatedDescription: For many people, coffee is an indispensable part of the morning routine. A cup of coffee can help us wake up, increase alertness and start the day easier. However, not everyone's body reacts to caffeine in the same way.

data.title: "Savjetovali su mi da radim u banci": Haris Tabaković otvorio dušu o strahovima, egu i najtežim danima u karijeri
data.description: Bosanskohercegovački reprezentativac Haris Tabaković u nedavnom je intervjuu za "Behind The Athletes" potpuno otvoreno i bez zadrške govorio o trnovitom putu koji je prošao u svojoj nogometnoj karijeri.
data.translatedTitle: "They advised me to work in a bank": Haris Tabaković opened up about his fears, ego and the most difficult days in his career
data.translatedDescription: In a recent interview for "Behind The Athletes", Bosnia and Herzegovina national team player Haris Tabaković spoke completely openly and without reservation about the thorny path he went through in his football career.

data.title: Nakon Macklemorea i YouTube zvijezda Ms Rachel najavila da će donirati milion dolara za Palestinu
data.description: YouTube zvijezda Ms Rachel poručila je da će i ona donirati milion dolara organizacijama koje podržavaju Palestince nakon što je to napravio reper Macklemore, pozivajući i druge javne ličnosti da slijede taj primjer.
data.translatedTitle: After Macklemore and YouTube star Ms Rachel announced that she would donate $1 million to Palestine
data.translatedDescription: YouTube star Ms Rachel said she too will donate $1 million to organizations supporting the Palestinians after rapper Macklemore did, urging other public figures to follow suit.

data.title: Amerikanci vratili Kini kulturna dobra, umjetnička djela i fosile koji su ukradeni prije 100 godina
data.description: Sjedinjene Američke Države su vratile dvije pošiljke s ukupno 64 kineska kulturna dobra, umjetnička djela i paleontološka fosila, među kojima je i statua bodhisattve iz pećina Tianlongshan u sjevernoj kineskoj provinciji Shanxi, koja je opljačkana i prije više od jednog stoljeća iznesena iz zemlje.
data.translatedTitle: Americans returned to China cultural property, works of art and fossils that were stolen 100 years ago
data.translatedDescription: The United States has returned two shipments containing a total of 64 Chinese cultural properties, works of art and paleontological fossils, including a bodhisattva statue from the Tianlongshan Caves in northern China's Shanxi province, which was looted and taken out of the country more than a century ago.

data.title: Parlamentarni izbori u Rusiji: Opozicija postoji samo u tragovima, Putin će ponovo imati apsolutnu moć
data.description: U Rusiji je u petak počelo trodnevno glasanje na parlamentarnim izborima, prvim od početka rata u Ukrajini, na kojima se očekuje novo učvršćivanje političke dominacije Kremlja.
data.translatedTitle: Parliamentary elections in Russia: The opposition exists only in traces, Putin will once again have absolute power
data.translatedDescription: In Russia, three days of voting began on Friday in the parliamentary elections, the first since the beginning of the war in Ukraine, where the Kremlin's political dominance is expected to be consolidated again.

data.title: Otkriveni planovi Pentagona: Razmatra se povlačenje 25.000 američkih trupa iz Evrope
data.description: Pentagon razmatra radikalan plan povlačenja aviona, brodova, naoružanja i desetina hiljada američkih vojnika iz Evrope, uprkos upozorenjima saveznika iz NATO-a o sve većoj prijetnji ruske agresije, piše NBC.

data.title: WSJ ⟩ Mäletate veel, kui demokraadid toetasid Ukrainat?

Sel nädalal Esindajatekojas toimunud hääletusel selgus, et lõviosa demokraate pole valmis toetama tugevamaid sanktsioone Vladimir Putini Venemaa vastu, kui see tähendaks koostööd vabariiklastega. Demokraatide valijad liberaalsetes eeslinnades peaksid uuendama oma majaesised plakatid.
data.translatedTitle: WSJ ⟩ Remember when Democrats supported Ukraine?
data.translatedDescription: It is not clear how many Democratic congressmen are still flying Ukrainian flags on their banners and homepages. But most of them have decided that it is now safe to show that they have other priorities. A vote in the House of Representatives this week revealed that the lion's share of Democrats are unwilling to support stronger sanctions against Vladimir Putin's Russia if that means working with Republicans. Democratic voters in liberal suburbs should update their front-door posters.

data.translatedTitle: A hybrid of an electron microscope and a quantum computer can reveal the details of matter without destroying it

Scientists have now found a way to prevent this. Crossing with a quantum computer can "suck out" information from the electrons coming from the sample in the electron microscope, which cannot be obtained in any other way.

data.title: Romania: a strategic choice for investors. 30 years of French-Romanian partnership: the way forward
data.description: Over 4,200 companies with majority French capital operate on the local market, generating approximately 125,000 jobs. The French presence spans nearly all key economic sectors: the automotive and manufacturing industries, energy, financial services, retail, IT, aeronautics, agriculture, and construction. Beyond the figures, these investments have brought new technologies, expertise, and working standards that have contributed to the modernization of the Romanian business environment. 30 years of commercial bonds and progress We live today in a world vastly different from the one we knew thirty years ago. The evolution has been systemic, encompassing the transition from a closed economy to a market economy, Romania's accession to the EU and transatlantic structures, and the natural evolution of society alongside technological advancements such as the advent of the internet, large-scale telecommunications, digitalization, AI, and workflow automation. All these developments place Romania firmly on investors' radars today, particularly given the structural competitive advantages already mentioned. The Romanian economy has reached maturity, driven primarily by the professionalism fostered through the exchange of expertise between local human capital and the experience brought by investors from mature markets. Foreign investment, the absorption of European funds, and the adoption of professional standards have all contributed to a process of widespread progress. "We are also witnessing a shift in the investment paradigm: a transition from the low-cost/best-cost model toward one focused on added value. This shift is possible precisely because the market has matured and is capable of delivering high-end services and added value, rather than merely supplying raw materials or low-cost labor." said Nicolas Richard, President of CCIFER. 100% trust in Romania According to a study conducted by CCIFER in April 2026, which received about 100 answers from C-level executives of the member companies, when asked if they still see their business developing in Romania, 100% of the respondents stated YES. "Therefore, the strongest message of the community is that Romania is a strategic bet, even amidst a context marked by geopolitical uncertainty, budgetary pressure, and legislative volatility."* said Adriana Record, Executive Director of CCIFER. How to attract more investors from France The most significant obstacles to Romania's development are identified in the same study mentioned above as being mostly at an institutional level: political instability, legislative unpredictability, bureaucracy, corruption, insufficient administrative capacity, and the lack of a long-term strategic vision. However, Romania continues to benefit from key structural advantages: competitive human capital, membership in the European Union and NATO, a favorable geostrategic position, and significant competitive potential in sectors such as energy, industry, agriculture, and technology. As perceived by the CCIFER community, the way to maintain investors' appetite is to continue capitalizing on the structural competitive advantages also identified in the study. First and foremost, Romania's membership in the European community and NATO represents a strategic competitive advantage over other countries in the region. Another extremely valuable strategic resource, recognized by all respondents as an absolute competitive advantage, is human capital: highly talented individuals who are eager to learn, resilient in the face of current challenges, and solution-oriented. Economic sectors with competitive potential and an impact on regional security, such as energy, represent another strategic factor. In the meantime, while maximizing strengths, it is also important to tackle the key identified barriers to economic development: political instability, legislative unpredictability, bureaucracy, corruption, insufficient administrative capacity, and the lack of a long-term strategic vision. By supporting and intensifying dialogue between public institutions and the business community, public policies become more aligned with economic realities, a role CCIFER has played in Romania for 30 years through dedicated sessions, sector-specific events, and community-generated position papers. Foster sustained joint efforts, such as the partnership CCIFER has conducted in education with the country's dual education institutions and the university sector, aimed at bridging the gap between actual labor market needs and the skills acquired in schools, while also actively identifying career opportunities for young graduates. Leverage on public-private partnership projects and a coherent regulatory framework for such initiatives can serve as a strategic solution to address the identified challenges. Looking towards the next 30 years "Looking ahead for the next thirty years, the CCIFER community envisions a prosperous, modern, European Romania and, above all, a place that feels like home: a place where people choose to stay. In this context, CCIFER embraces the role of a key player in fostering cohesion and influence, and in facilitating dialogue between the business community and the authorities."* said Nicolas Richard, President of CCIFER. As it enters its fourth decade of activity, CCIFER aims to continue expanding its community, with a strong focus on SMEs and regional development, to help build the skills of the future, and to intensify dialogue with authorities on key issues such as taxation, infrastructure, the reduction of bureaucracy, and digitalization. Romania possesses valuable assets: talent, creativity, a strategic location, and significant potential in sectors such as energy, agriculture, industry, and technology. The challenge lies no longer in identifying opportunities, but in creating a coherent framework that allows them to be fully leveraged. For 30 years, this has been the core objective of the conversation CCIFER conducts with its partners: to contribute to building a more competitive and sustainable economy.

data.title: Documentary on Romania's 'Ice Man' Tibi Uşeriu to have U.S. premiere next month
data.description: The Ultra Runner , the story of Romanian ultramarathon champion Tibi Ușeriu, is scheduled to have its U.S. premiere next month, following its world premiere at the Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF) last week. The documentary, directed by Burmese-Canadian filmmaker Mila Aung-Thwin, will have its first U.S. screening at the Chicago International Film Festival on October 19, with an additional public screening on October 20. The film will continue to make its way across the festival circuit, namely at Atlantic International Film Festival on September 19 & 21, Lunenburg Doc Fest on September 25, and more, before its release in theatres across Canada in spring of 2027. The film follows Tibi Ușeriu, a three-time winner of the 6633 Arctic Ultra race , as he “battles endless terrain and his own demons in search of a better life for his family, his country, and himself.” He fled the country after the 1989 Revolution and went from serving time in jail for most of his young years to being “an example of reintegration and found running as his outlet for a sense of liberation.” He has won four Arctic competitions, with more than 3,000 km run. He shared his story in the autobiographical bestseller 27 Steps . The book helped kick-start the initiation of Via Transilvanica, the long-distance trail crossing Romania. The trail is a project of NGO Tășuleasa Social, established by Tibi’s brother, Alin Uşeriu. https://youtu.be/2k44lH1KRUo?si=fel4GDPLsBM8S_dk The film is produced by Montreal's EYESTEELFILM and Ontario-based production house Winterhouse Pictures.

data.title: Who is Siegfried Mureşan, the prime minister-designate of Romania?
data.description: He currently serves as vice-president of the European People’s Party (EPP), the largest group in the EP, and vice-president of the EPP Group in the European Parliament. Early life Siegfried Mureşan was born on September 20, 1981, in Hunedoara, to a Romanian father and an ethnic German mother from the Transylvanian Saxon community, hence his German-sounding first name. He graduated from the German-language section of the Bucharest University of Economic Studies in 2004 and continued his studies with a master’s degree in economics and management at Humboldt University in Berlin. He was a scholarship holder and later an adviser to the chairman of the Committee on European Affairs in the German Parliament (Bundestag), Gunther Krichbaum, for three years, according to News.ro . From 2011, he worked as a senior political adviser on economic issues within the EPP in Brussels. Siegfried Mureşan is married to Cătălina Manea, a fraud prevention expert at the European Investment Bank in Luxembourg. He speaks German, English and French fluently. Political career Siegfried Mureşan officially entered Romanian politics in 2014, when he was elected MEP on the lists of the People’s Movement Party (PMP), a party created at the initiative of former president Traian Băsescu. During that period, he campaigned for Băsescu’s ally and protege Elena Udrea, and was proposed by the president for the position of prime minister. In 2018, he moved to the National Liberal Party (PNL), subsequently also becoming president of the PNL Diaspora organization. Mureşan’s European profile is one of his strongest assets, according to his supporters. He is the first Romanian to have served as the European Parliament’s lead negotiator for the EU’s annual budget in 2018 and 2024. His financial expertise was also essential in negotiating the future Multiannual Budget (2028-2034), managing a package estimated at approximately two trillion euros, and supporting the funding of agriculture and cohesion policy. Moreover, he served as co-rapporteur for the implementation of the NRRP, managing to include provisions favorable to Romania, such as increasing the advance payment and the period for using the funds. At present, he is chairman of the European Parliament Delegation for relations with the Republic of Moldova, being a vocal supporter of its accession to the EU and negotiator for financial packages to modernize infrastructure across the small country. For these efforts, he was awarded the "Order of Honor" by Maia Sandu in 2021. Critics All major political leaders reacted to Mureșan’s appointment as prime minister. While the National Liberal Party (PNL), Save Romania Union (USR), and the Hungarian minority party UDMR expressed support for their candidate for PM, the Social Democratic Party (PSD) and the far-right Alliance for the Union of Romanians (AUR) rejected the appointment. PSD leader Sorin Grindeanu said on Thursday, September 17, that he would advise his colleagues in Parliament to vote against the investiture of the Mureșan government. “Siegfried Mureșan will fall with glory in Parliament. That is my bet,” Grindeanu commented, according to G4Media . Lia Olguța Vasilescu, the PSD mayor of Craiova and a dominating figure in the party, said Mureșan “has no idea what it is like to live in Romania.” She further claimed that “Romanians will twist their tongues trying to pronounce his name,” referring to the PM-designate’s German-sounding first name, according to Euronews Romania . AUR president George Simion, in turn, said his party will not vote for any government in which AUR is not part. After Mureșan’s appointment, he made a post on Facebook suggesting that the PM-designate was a stand-in for Germany. He also hinted at a “hidden agreement” between Nicușor Dan and PSD, stressing that no stable majority could be formed without the votes of the party he leads. In search of a majority To become Romania’s next prime minister, Siegfried Mureșan needs to gather a majority of MPs in the Parliament. PNL, USR and UDMR have only 169 of the 233 votes needed.  Even if he were to obtain all 17 votes of the national minorities group, the three parties supporting him would reach 186 and would still need another 47 MPs. PSD said it will vote only for a government it is part of, meaning an Executive in which the Social Democrats have ministers, according to Antena 3 . USR ruled out participation in a government together with PSD, but this position may change in the coming days. Siegfried Mureșan himself said before the designation that he did not see a formula in which PNL would govern alongside the Social Democrats. UDMR rules out a majority that would depend on the votes of AUR, SOS Romania, or other formations it considers extremist or anti-Hungarian. These conditions seriously narrow the options on the designated prime minister’s table. If Siegfried Mureșan’s cabinet fails to obtain the 233 votes needed, this would be the second request for an investiture to be rejected. As the 60-day deadline has already been exceeded, the two central conditions that allow the president to consider dissolving Parliament and, implicitly, early elections would be met.

data.title: Iași City Hall launches EUR 113 mln tender for new multipurpose arena
data.description: The City Hall of Iași, in eastern Romania, launched a public tender for the construction of the Regina Maria Multipurpose Arena, a major sports complex planned in the Moara de Vânt area. The contract is valued at RON 596.35 million, including VAT, or approximately EUR 113 million. “Iași City Hall is looking for a builder for the Multipurpose Arena,” the municipality announced on Facebook. Construction companies can submit bids until October 26, while the maximum completion period is 48 months. The city said it would initially finance the works from its local budget and later transfer the project to the National Investment Company (CNI) for co-financing from the state budget. The Iași Local Council approved an increase in the municipality’s contribution from 20% to 25% of the project’s value in April 2026. The project’s updated overall estimate, which also includes costs beyond the construction tender, stands at approximately RON 680.1 million. data.title: Bucharest Exchange-listed dairy Agroserv Măriuța reports shrinking profit amid expansion strategy
data.description: The company said the weaker profitability came as it expanded factory activity and strengthened the position of the Lăptăria cu Caimac brand, while consumers remained cautious and cost pressures stayed high. Factory volumes increased by 13% year-on-year in H1, while the share of milk from Agroserv Măriuța’s own farm used in processing rose to 74%, the company said. The higher proportion of own-produced milk supports its integrated production model and allows it to use more of the processing capacity developed in recent years. “In the first half of 2026, we continued to expand the factory's activity and strengthen the market position of the Lăptăria cu Caimac brand,” Cornel Dănilă, general manager of Agroserv Măriuța, said. He said the company had continued to pursue higher volumes and stronger commercial relationships despite the temporary impact on margins and profitability. “We chose this approach to increase our market share and create a more solid basis for future development,” Dănilă said. The company said the expansion strategy was implemented against a backdrop of cautious consumer spending and persistent cost pressures. The focus on volumes and market penetration has therefore come at the expense of short-term profitability as Agroserv seeks to strengthen its position in the dairy market. Agroserv Măriuța plans to focus during the second half of 2026 on gradually improving margins while maintaining the commercial gains achieved in the first six months. “In the second half of the year, our objective is to gradually improve margins, while maintaining the commercial progress achieved so far, so as to end 2026 in line with the approved budget,” Dănilă said. The company, listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange under the ticker MILK, operates an integrated dairy business spanning its own farm, milk processing and the Lăptăria cu Caimac consumer brand.

data.title: UniCredit Romania gets Moody's rating above country’s sovereign
data.description: The Baa1 rating assigned to UniCredit Bank is two notches above Romania's sovereign rating, "reflecting both the bank's solid financial profile and the solid support from the UniCredit Group," the bank said. "The rating granted by Moody's represents an independent confirmation of the financial soundness of UniCredit Bank Romania and its credit profile. This assessment reflects the discipline with which we manage capital and liquidity, the resilience of our business model and the bank's development prospects," said Mihaela Lupu, CEO of UniCredit Bank. Moody’s also assigned UniCredit Bank Romania a Baseline Credit Assessment (BCA) of ba1 and an Adjusted BCA of baa2, with the latter reflecting the very high likelihood of support from UniCredit Group, which owns 89.1% of the bank’s capital and considers its Romanian operations strategically important, the source also said.
